eps.t: Honey, I Shrunk the Rangers, Pt. 1
Honey, I Shrunk the Rangers, Pt. 2

eps.ov: Rita Repulsa escapes after 10,000 years of imprisonment determined to conquer Earth but a team of teenagers with attitude stands in her way.
Bulk and his gang seek to ruin the food festival while Rita sends a gluttonous pig to eat everything on Earth.
Trini must overcome her fear of heights to save Billy.
Kimberly and Trini gather signatures to close down a nearby dumpsite while convincing their teammates to work together more.
Jason battles King Sphinx while trying to break a bench press record at the Angel Grove Gym & Juice Bar.
Kimberly's deaf friend is the only hope to rescue a group of girls captured by the Gnarly Gnome and his hypnotic accordion.
Rita sends her monster Eye Guy to kidnap Billy's bright young protégé.
Trini's favorite doll is brought to life by Rita Repulsa and commanded to capture the Rangers inside bottles.
Zack worries that his friends have forgotten today is his birthday while Rita sends him an unwelcome present.
The gang fights Rita's minions at a carnival in order to save Trini's cousin Sylvia.
The gang fights Rita's minions at a carnival in order to save Trini's cousin Sylvia.
Baboo sneaks a magic potion into Kimberly and Billy's drinks that turns them into angry punks.
Billy draws on the powers of his friends to rescue the girl of his dreams.
Billy is inspired by Trini's uncle Howard - a brilliant scientist and expert in martial arts.
Kimberly and Trini look after a mischievous little girl named Maria.
Billy's latest invention goes haywire causing him and Kimberly to switch bodies.

eps.t: Green with Evil Part 1: Out of Control
eps.ov: Rita creates her own evil Green Ranger to beat the Power Rangers at their own game.

eps.t: Green with Evil Part 2: Jason's Battle
eps.ov: The Power Rangers work to restore Zordon and Alpha unaware that the new kid in school is actually Rita's evil Green Ranger.

eps.t: Green with Evil Part 3: The Rescue
eps.ov: Femme fatale Scorpina joins Rita as the Green Ranger continues to battle the Power Rangers.

eps.t: Green with Evil Part 4: Eclipsing Megazord
eps.ov: An eclipse of the sun saps the Megazord's power as Rita's forces launch a full scale assault on Angel Grove.

eps.t: Green with Evil Part 5: Breaking the Spell
eps.ov: The mighty Dragonzord awakes after thousands of years as the Rangers try to break the spell over the Green Ranger once and for all.
Squatt and Baboo create their own Shellshock monster to impress Rita.
Rita and her evil Spit Flower monster set out to ruin Kimberly's design for a float in the world peace parade.
Zack must overcome his fear of spiders to face Rita's newest monster.
Rita's Frankenstein monster crashes the Power Rangers' Halloween costume party.
Jason and Tommy must learn to work together to stop Rita's Super Putties.
Rita turns Kimberly's grandmother's spinning wheel into her dangerous new weapon.
Rita traps the Power Rangers on the Island of Illusion, where their greatest fears can destroy them.
The Rangers must overcome their own fears to escape Rita's Island of Illusion.
Jason and his cousin Jeremy find a map that leads to a powerful ancient mirror.
Kimberly's day goes from bad to worse when the Samurai Fanman captures her.
Tommy is called to rescue his friends while given the opportunity to audition for a martial arts commercial.

With the Angel Grove High talent show around the corner, the Rangers have a lot to deal with when Tommy is kidnapped and imprisoned by putties, and Finster creates the Fang monster in celebration of Rita's birthday.
Rita uses a green candle to wipe out the Green Ranger once and for all.
As Jason journeys to the dimensional prison to stop the green candle from burning out, Tommy battles the Cyclops with the Dragonzord.
While Zack trains a young student for a karate tournament, Rita sends her Hatchasaurus monster down to Earth.
The Ranger teens form a Clean-Up Club and take part in cleaning up Angel Grove Park, but Rita has plans of her own and sends the Polluticorn monster after them.
Rita creates a team of evil duplicates of the Power Rangers to frame them.
Rita unveils her own evil Zord as she brings her entire palace from the Moon to Angel Grove.
The Power Rangers fight to rescue the citizens of Angel Grove from Rita, Lokar and Cyclopsis.
While the Rangers plant trees in the park, Squatt plants an evil seed that grows into the Octoplant.
Rita casts a spell on a helpless pig turning him into the Pudgy Pig monster.
Billy must overcome his fear of fish to save his friends from Rita's fishy new monster.
Zack finally gets a date with the girl of his dreams at the same time as Rita turns the Noble Lion Trophy into her latest monster.
The teens go to the mountains for the weekend to study for a test while Goldar readies the Crystal of Nightmares to infiltrate the Rangers' dreams.

eps.t: To Flea or Not to Flee
eps.ov: Jason tries to find the owner of a stray dog while the Rangers try to save Ernie's Gym & Juice Bar from going out of business.
Rita--determined to prevent future generations from remembering the Power Rangers--tries to stop them from burying a time capsule.
Trini struggles to learn praying mantis style kung fu to defeat Rita's latest monster.
Rita demands the Power Rangers hand over their Power Coins if they ever want to see their parents again.
With their Power Coins in the hands of the enemy the Rangers have no choice but to turn to Tommy once more for help.
Billy gets his first 'B' on a science test giving Rita the idea to send her Grumble Bee to Earth.

eps.t: Two Heads are Better Than One
eps.ov: Jason and Tommy teach a self-defense class to women while the Rangers fight a two-headed parrot monster.
Zack juggles watching over a group of children with battling the Peckster.
Kimberly competes against Skull on a game show for a chance to win a brand new car while the Pumpkin Rapper seeks to ambush the Rangers.
Jason and Zack coach a young boy to help him make Ernie's junior soccer team.
The Slippery Shark monster casts a spell over Jason and Tommy causing them to fight amongst each other.
Kimberly helps her younger cousin try out for the Angel Grove Junior High cheerleading team while Rita sends the mighty Lizzinator to Earth.
Tommy tries to learn how to play football in time to make the high school team and to stop Rita's Rhino Blaster.
Tommy works on improving his memory while Rita creates a team of evil Mutant Rangers led by Commander Crayfish.
Zack seeks to impress Angela by giving her a pair of pearl earrings, unaware they are Rita's cursed Pearls of Stillness.
Rita Repulsa's minions abandon her when an even more evil menace arrives on the Moon.
Lord Zedd steals the power of the Zords away from the Rangers.
The Power Rangers obtain new Zords to defeat Pirantishead.
Lord Zedd attacks with a monster that can morph from one Power Ranger to another.
Lord Zedd casts a spell on the Power Rangers.
Kimberly is attacked by the Bloom of Doom, a poisonous plant.
Goldar plans to steal Tommy's Green Ranger powers.
While cleaning up Angel Grove, the teens get trapped by the Octophantom monster who attempts to drain the Rangers of their powers.
The Stag Beetle Monster drains Tommy's powers in an attack on Angel Grove.
Rangers face Monster Venus Fly Traps as they try to rescue Hallie from Lord Zedd's island stronghold.
Kimberly is the only one who can save the Rangers from a musical spell.
A giant Turban Shell captures Tommy and transports him to Zedd's Otherworld.
Tommy attempts to retrieve the Rangers' Morphers and escape from Zedd's Otherworld.
Jason's guilt of Tommy's loss of power causes even more problems for the Power Rangers.
The Power Rangers must toot their own horns to stop Lord Zedd's Trumpet Top.
Kimberly is captured and transformed into Lord Zedd's evil queen.
Alpha and Zordon go on a secret mission, leaving the Power Rangers to fend for themselves.
Zordon introduces the team to the new White Ranger and his mighty White Tiger Zord.
Lord Zedd fashions unfeminine monsters from Kimberly's stolen purse.
Lord Zedd plans to steal Billy's magnetic polarizing gauge and wreak havoc with the Earth's gravitational pull.
Tommy faces some real Halloween monsters after he's kidnapped by Goldar.
Lord Zedd tries to recruit winners of a Ninja Tournament to his cause, but the Rangers have other plans.
The Power Rangers attempt to save their young ninja friends from the clutches of Lord Zedd.
Billy must risk revealing his real identity to save his new ninja friends.
Lord Zedd tries to sabotage the first World Teen Summit.
Beamcaster controls the minds of Angel Grove's citizens, turning them into Zedd's Zombies.
The Rangers must stop Zedd as he unleashes an awesome new weapon to attack the planet.
Three departing Rangers transfer their powers to the new Rangers who are immediately called into battle against the Silver Horns Monster.
Adam discovers his attractive hiking partner is taking him on a trail to nowhere.
Zedd tries to use the Mirror of Regret to undermine Adam's confidence.

eps.t: When is a Ranger Not a Ranger?
eps.ov: Bulk and Skull must save the Power Rangers from the Scatterbrain Monster.

eps.t: Rocky Just Wants to Have Fun
eps.ov: Lord Zedd casts a spell on Rocky causing him to become obsessed with playing a pachinko game.
Lord Zedd tries to break into show biz, but the Rangers show him the true meaning of rejection.
Aisha learns the value of being part of a team when all the Rangers are needed to deal with the Flame Head Monster.
Zedd turns the gang's scavenger hunt into a fight for survival.
The Rangers try to help Bookala, a friendly alien, return to his planet.
Zedd sends the huge Jaws of Destruction to destroy the Power Rangers.
Zedd creates some underwater monsters to scare a young swimmer.
Zedd turns back time reverting the Rangers back into helpless children.
Alpha attempts to save the Power Rangers and restore them to their rightful ages.
Rita Repulsa drugs Lord Zedd with a love potion and launches her own attack against the Rangers.
Zedd proposes to Rita, and she promises to deliver the defeated Rangers as a wedding present.
Rita and Zedd marry and decide to spend their honeymoon destroying the Power Rangers.
The Evil Green Ranger returns and Tommy is forced to confront him alone.
The Rangers are stuck in the year 1774 and find they are unable to morph as the evil Green Ranger continues his destructive rampage.
The world hangs in the balance as the White Ranger and Green Ranger face off in a final showdown.
Rita and Zedd turn the class election into an ugly rivalry for Kimberly and Tommy.
Rita traps Kimberly, Tommy and Rocky inside a book of fairy tales.
Fairy tale monsters prove to be a challenge for the Rangers.
Kimberly is transported through a time hole to the 1800s where she meets the Power Rangers' wild west ancestors.
Kimberly helps the Rangers' ancestors morph into "Wild West Rangers" to fight the Needle Nose monster and save the world.
Rita and Zedd create an evil Blue Ranger from a high school art project.
The Rangers travel to Edenoi to check on Alpha's creator, when they encounter the Masked Rider, who believes they have come to harm him.
The Rangers and the Masked Rider team up to fight Count Dregon's warriors.
The Rangers rush back to Earth to fight off an attack by Repelletor.
Rita's brother, Rito Revolto, promises to destroy the Power Rangers as a late wedding present for his sister.
The Rangers search for the mythical sage Ninjor in an effort to restore their lost powers.
The Rangers receive new Ninja Powers and new Zords to battle Rito Revolto in his attempt to destroy Angel Grove.
Rita and Zedd unleash Vampirus against the Ranger's new Zords.
Based on Kimberly's dream, Rita and Zedd create the Artistmole monster who steals the color out of life.
Rita and Zedd attempt to steal Adam's heirloom lantern for its power.
Rito and Zedd turn a science teacher into "Marvo the Meanie" as Rocky attempts to teach his class.
Rocky must drop kick Rita and Zedd to save the Rangers from Centiback, a monster who changes people into footballs.
The Hate Master causes the Power Rangers to fight among themselves and make plans to quit.
Aisha holds the secret to stopping the Hate Master and reuniting the Rangers.
The Face Stealer monster mugs Bulk and Skull for their mugs until it's faced with its own medicine.
Rito's love potion creates havoc in Angel Grove.
The Rangers must choose between saving Tommy or stopping Rito's destructive rampage.
Tommy is forced to defend himself against Goldar and Rito.
Zedd and Rita capture Ninjor and his power source with plans to activate a set of dormant Zords.
Zedd uses the kidnapped Kimberly to blackmail the Rangers.
Kimberly's safety depends on the Rangers piloting Zedd's Zords.
Kimberly, Bulk, and Skull are taken on a wild ride by the Crabbie Cabbie monster.
Rita vows to keep Kimberly out of the gymnastics competition for the Pan Global Games.
Rita and Zedd use Ninjor to bargain for the return of Katherine.
Kimberly has to make the most critical decision of her life, to stay a Power Ranger, or follow her dream to become a world class gymnast.
The junk food Ravenator threatens to destroy Tommy -- from the inside out.
Katherine and Billy try to save the other Rangers from the Brick Bully.
Rita and Zedd change a pet chimp used by Katherine and Aisha for a school project into a Sinister Simian.

eps.t: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (1)
eps.ov: Rita's father, Master Vile, arrives to do what she and Zedd have failed to do -- destroy the Rangers.

eps.t: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (2)
eps.ov: Master Vile and his evil crew appear to be winning the battle against the Power Rangers.

eps.t: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (3)
eps.ov: The Rangers decide the only way to win against Master Vile is to journey to a distant galaxy.

eps.t: I'm Dreaming of a White Ranger
eps.ov: The Power Rangers are forced to try to save Christmas -- without their powers.
Master Vile has sent the devious Dischordia to put the Power Rangers under a terrible tune.
Master Vile turns back time to gain control of the Earth and turn the Rangers into helpless children.
Zordon calls on the Alien Rangers to help defend the Earth after the Power Rangers are made helpless.
Alien Rangers defends the Earth against Master Vile and his army of monsters.
Billy and the young Rangers devise a scheme to outsmart the monsters.
Billy and the young Rangers attempt to free the Alien Rangers from a toxic lake.
Rita and Zedd turn Bulk into the Brat Boy monster.
The young Rangers search for their pieces of the Zeo Crystal to recover their powers.
In the distant past, Adam searches across Korea for his Zeo Crystal.
Tommy and Katherine continue their search for their individual Zeo Crystals.
Zedd and Rita send the Hydro Hog to Earth to suck up all the water.
Aisha faces a difficult decision in her Zeo Quest while the Alien Rangers battle Hydro Hog.
In the rubble of the destroyed Command Center, the Power Rangers find the Zeo Crystal.
The Rangers face their greatest challenge as Zordon explains that King Mondo is preparing to invade the Solar System, his final link in a chain of galaxies he already controls.
When Mondo and Machina unleash the Staroid on the Zeo Rangers, they are forced to call on their untested Zeo Zords.
The computer software that Rocky, and his new friend Jennifer are working on, is stolen by the Cogs and used against the Rangers.
Tommy and Katherine take care of a baby for a school assignment giving King Mondo an idea for his evil ambitions.
The teens' baseball team provides the perfect outlet for Prince Sprocket to do battle with the Rangers when he turns their batting machine into the People Pitcher.
Smokey, a specially trained dog, aids the Zeo Rangers in fighting Digster, Mondo and Machina's latest monster.

When Ernie brings a puppet show to the Youth Center to entertain the children of Angel Grove, Mondo and Machina hatch a plan to control the children's minds, by planting a transmitter on the Puppet Man.
Prince Sprocket recruits the Rangers to be in his own twisted movie; "Invasion of the Ranger Snatchers."
As Billy learns he has accumulated enough credits to graduate from Angel Grove High, Cestro, the Blue Alien Ranger, lands on Earth seeking Billy's help.
As Rocky and Adam work on developing hybrid plants for Botany class, Rocky's plant exhibits weird behavior, growing rapidly and developing an appetite for metal.
A mysterious musician in Angel Grove High is pursued by Prince Sprocket and King Mondo.

Tanya and Adam are exploring the new world of cyberspace with the help of Raymond, a computer whiz, at school. When they run into a computer virus, Mondo gets the idea to create Mean Screen, a horrible computer monster that will infect all of the computers in Angel Grove.
As Billy is returning from Aquitar in a space capsule, Machina and Mondo attack his space craft, sending it into the gravitational pull of the Machine Skybase.

eps.t: There's No Business Like Snow Business (1)
eps.ov: Tommy receives a "Dear John" letter.

eps.t: There's No Business Like Snow Business (2)
eps.ov: Mondo and Machina send the Defoliator to create a greenhouse effect in Angel Grove.

eps.t: There's No Business Like Snow Business (3)
eps.ov: As Katherine tries to console Tommy about his "Dear John" letter from Kimberly, a spark of attraction begins to form between the two Rangers.
On a journey to find True of Heart, Tommy comes upon the incredible discovery of a young man who looks just like him.
Searching for the other half of an arrowhead, Tommy discovers its owner is his brother.
Having kidnapped Tommy's newfound brother David, King Mondo blackmails Tommy into giving up his half of the arrowhead, in order to set David free.

eps.t: Brother, Can You Spare an Arrowhead?
eps.ov: Now that he has both halves of the arrowhead, King Mondo vows to destroy the Zeo Rangers, while continuing to refuse the release of Tommy's brother.
King Mondo sends down the Defector robot to trick the Zeo Rangers into gaining their trust, and thereby able to destroy them.
Adam experiences a nightmarish scenario when the Machine Empire invades Earth overnight and transforms many of Adam's friends into sinister scientists, werewolves, and dark forces.
Bulk's infatuation with the daughter of a high ranking officer soon puts both his, Skull's, and Lt. Stone's careers in jeopardy.
Tanya's potential new singing career divides her time between fulfilling an ambition and serving as a Ranger
King Mondo attempts to rule the Earth's waterways by building a fleet of ships under an invisible field.
King Mondo's plan to divide and conquer the Zeo Rangers is spoiled by the appearance of the Gold Ranger.
The other Rangers must find a way to help their friends when Prince Sprocket shrinks Tommy and Katherine and places them in a terrarium with a hungry spider.

eps.t: Oily to Bed, Oily to Rise
eps.ov: Katherine competes in a surfing competition, but faces danger when the Leaky Faucet monster puts toxic Cog oil in all the water in Angel Grove.
The Somnibot casts a sleeping spell on the people of Angel Grove, leaving it to the Gold Ranger to break the spell.
The Gold Ranger finds asylum in the Power Chamber from the evil Mondo, Machina, and the Varox bounty hunter.
When the Gold Ranger is attacked by Varox Bounty Hunters, Pyramidas is hit, and falls into the seas of the planet Aquitar.
Time is running out for transference of the Golden Powers.
King Mondo is determined to use the Damocles Sword to destroy the Zeo Rangers.
The teens are helping Ernie set up for his new Beach Club when a group of tough teens ride in and begin to trash the place.
The teens are involved in a charity fashion show for the famous designer, Mr. Stenchy.
Aisha sends Tanya a map of Mysterio Island, the island on which Tanya suspects her parents have been missing for years.

eps.t: The Ranger Who Came in from the Gold
eps.ov: When Katherine stages a ballet about King Midas, Louie Kaboom creates the Midas Hound, an idol that changes everything into gold.

A practical joker wrecks havoc on Angel Grove High. While Bulk and Skull try to track down the trickster, Prince Sprocket's brother, Prince Gasket and sister-in-law, Archerina, arrive with a few new tricks of their own!

eps.t: Where In The World is Zeo Ranger 5?
eps.ov: While jet skiing on the lake, Tommy is mysteriously disappears.
The Zeo Rangers discover that Tommy has been captured by Prince Gasket, and placed in a large arena with monsters battling one another.
The Gold Ranger is forced to defend himself when the brainwashed Tommy attacks him.
Tommy is confused when he keeps reliving experiences of the day over and over.
The teens all dress in classic mystery character costumes when they participate in a charity dinner organized by Detective Stone.
Tommy asks Tanya for voice lessons when he has to sing in front of the class.
Everyone is stunned when it is revealed that Billy has aged into an old man.
The Power Rangers Zeo team up with the Alien Rangers of Aquitar to combat a double threat from King Mondo and Lord Zedd.
The golden powers start to fade from Jason.
Jason, who is continuing to lose the golden powers, is confronted by Rita and Lord Zedd.
The Rangers, together with their friend Raymond, help Ernie set up for a multicultural holiday banquet, and in the process learn how different cultures celebrate the holidays.
Divatox returns to Earth seeking vengeance against the Power Rangers.
The Turbo Rangers race to stop Divatox from destroying the Angel Grove power plant during their graduation ceremony.
Zordon and Alpha 5 bid farewell to the planet Earth as Divatox escalates her assault on Angel Grove.
Divatox's Chromite steals the Turbo Rangers' morphing energy to create evil shadow Rangers.
A messenger from Dimitria's homeworld journeys to Earth with important news.
Justin competes in the Soap Box Derby while Porto goes AWOL from the Subcraft.
Adam battles the lightning-quick Demon Racer as he tries to stop his peers from a dangerous drag race.
Justin is trapped on a speeding bicycle in an explosive countdown to zero.
Divatox's Mouth Piece Monster makes Justin lie constantly with a Piranhatron appearing for every lie.
Divatox summons her ancient Egyptian ex-fiance Pharaoh to battle the Turbo Rangers.
Divatox sends Numbor to cause Angel Grove to sink into the ocean while Kat worries about her weight.
Divatox's forces set off false fire alarms all over Angel Grove as Justin deals with school bullies.
The Blue Senturion time travels to present-day Angel Grove with a message from the future for Dimitria.
Divatox sends Electrovolt to Angel Grove to ruin Adam's soccer team.
Wolfgang Amadeus Griller comes to Angel Grove in order to transform automobiles to life.
The Power Rangers are shrunk to the size of insects.
The micronized Turbo Rangers go on an action-packed trip trying to escape from Divatox's Subcraft.
The Rangers prepare for their final assignment while Divatox decides to capture Tommy.
Tommy, Kat, Adam, and Tanya pass their powers on to a new generation of Power Rangers.
Divatox uses Ashley's fashion jacket to control the minds of the citizens of Angel Grove as well as the Blue Senturion.
Two intelligent cars from outer space called Lightning Cruiser and Storm Blaster travel to Earth.
Divatox is struck by amnesia while the Power Rangers battle evil pizzas.
The mysterious Phantom Ranger appears on Earth to assist the Power Rangers.
The Rangers try to uncover why everything around them is disappearing including the Power Chamber.
Divatox attempts to control time in order to freeze the planet Earth.
General Havoc reinforces Divatox helping her capture the Turbo Megazord.
With no way to defend Angel Grove, the Rangers turn to the Phantom Ranger for assistance.
General Havoc and Divatox set a trap for the Phantom Ranger in order to capture his powerful Phantom Ruby.
The Turbo Rangers race to stop the Turbo Megazord and save the Phantom Ranger as his life force ebbs away.
Justin suspects that his fellow Rangers have been replaced by robots.
The Wicked Wisher grants Divatox three wishes. One of which she uses to turn the Blue Senturion evil.
The Power Rangers hurry to find the third wishing coin and restore the Blue Senturion.
The Torch Tiger steals the Turbo Rangers' super fuel turning him into an arsonist nightmare.

eps.t: The Turn of the Wretched Wrench
eps.ov: Ashley finds her auto mechanics class more difficult than she anticipated which is further complicated by her fellow student, the Maniac Mechanic.
T.J. meets a mysterious young boy in the forest named Erutan.
Cassie's new rock band turns out to be more than she bargained for.
When Carlos injures a rival, even he isn't sure if it was really by accident.
As Elgar repairs his Zord, Cassie loses her dog Jetson, but meets a mysterious new friend who knows her better than anyone.
T.J. needs to learn how to hit a curve ball if he's going to save his baseball team's chances of victory as well as the world.
An encounter with a mutated lunar bat leaves Carlos with an aversion to sunlight, and a powerful thirst - for blood!
Justin is given superhuman strength when a radioactive ant bites him. Meanwhile, Divatox pilots the first of her Divazords into battle against the Rangers.
Cassie and Ashley compete for the new kid in school's affections while Porto pilots the Shark Zord into battle.
T.J. tries to help Bulk and Skull find out who is raiding Angel Grove for spare parts.
Justin faces the possibility of having to move away as against overwhelming odds, the Turbo Rangers charge into their final battle.
The remaining Power Rangers blast off into outer space to try and save Zordon.
The Rangers and Alpha 6 are sucked into an unknown high tech space ship. Meanwhile, Dark Specter assembles many of the universe's most evil villains.
With the Astro Megaship stranded on an uninhabited planet and Astronema's forces closing in, the Red Ranger reveals his identity to the Rangers and presents them with new powers.
The Power Rangers return home to an explosive welcome on Earth from Ecliptor and Astronema.
The Space Rangers meet the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.
Andros returns to his home planet KO-35 in search of his long-lost sister.
NASADA asks the Rangers to help retrieve a crashed satellite with important data on Dark Specter's operations.
While the Rangers are busy taking a test in school, Andros gets mixed up with a group of car thieves.
Cassie is trapped in a building under attack by Astronema's forces.
A Simudeck malfunction causes the Craterites to multiply, escape, and attack Angel Grove.
A wasp monster doesn't have it in him to be evil, and he helps and befriends Cassie, who sticks up for him when confronted by the other Rangers. But the Rangers have to deal with the evil Sting King.
The Phantom Ranger discovers where Dark Specter is hiding Zordon.
Professor Phenomenus develops a ray that can turn objects evil. Astronema decides to use it against the Power Rangers.
Ashley's grandmother visits Angel Grove intent on seeing Ashley engaged before she leaves.
A suspicious bounty hunter joins forces with Astronema despite Ecliptor's objections.
Darkonda betrays Ecliptor to increase his own power. Meanwhile T.J. suffers an injury causing him to lose his memory.
Andros makes a startling discovery about his sister's kidnapper and journeys into the heart of Dark Specter's empire searching for answers.
The Power Rangers use their newly-obtained Key Cards to decode the location of a new fleet of Zords.
Justin, the Blue Turbo Ranger, returns to help the Power Rangers.
Astronema switches bodies with Ashley to infiltrate the Astro Megaship and capture the Power Rangers.
The Rangers discover the cryogenically frozen Zhane, the Silver Ranger and Andros' best friend.
Andros battles Darkonda and his own jealousy as he worries Ashley might be attracted to Zhane.
After being frozen for two years, Zhane struggles with his weakening Ranger powers.
Zhane struggles between his attraction to Astronema and his duty to help the other Power Rangers.
On a desolate planet, the Rangers are captured by a band of resistance fighters prompting Zhane to reconsider his place with the Power Rangers.
After accidentally hurting Cassie in battle, Carlos finds his self-confidence shaken prompting an old Mighty Morphin friend to lend a hand.
When Darkonda sets a trap for the Red Ranger, Andros finally comes face to face with his long-lost sister.
Astronema questions her own motives as she travels to KO-35 to battle the Power Rangers.
The Power Rangers question whether they can trust Astronema when she offers to help them find Zordon.
With a new ally aboard the Megaship, the Rangers race to save the Earth from an asteroid on a collision course with the planet.
An old ally returns to help Andros rescue his sister from Dark Specter
Astronema assembles a team of evil Psycho Rangers to solidify her power.
Carlos must appease a little girl's every whim to keep his identity a secret.
The Psycho Rangers take advantage of the animosity between the Ranger girls to capture Ashley.
T.J. devises a clever strategy to defeat the Psycho Rangers in battle.
Able to recognize the Power Rangers' voices, the Psycho Rangers assume human disguises to try and find them when they least suspect it.
While searching for their Mega Voyager, the Power Rangers prepare for a final showdown with the Psycho Rangers.
On a remote planet, Andros befriends a rapidly-growing baby alien on the run from his cruel master.
Andros and Carlos are trapped inside Astronema's Secret City forcing Andros to discover untapped powers in his Astro Morpher to save the day.
The Rangers race to stop Astronema from using her new device to turn people into Data Cards.
Astronema lures the Rangers into a trap on a distant planet.
The vehicular monster Takenstein stalks the Power Rangers in a vast desert.
Dark Specter's combined armies launch a final all-out assault on the entire universe.
With the forces of evil all but triumphant, the Power Rangers make one last desperate attempt to save Zordon.
An adventurous young man embarks on an epic adventure in space when he sneaks aboard the massive space colony Terra Venture.
The Galaxy Rangers are born as five heroes unite to protect the planet Mirinoi from the villain Furio.
The Rangers befriend the Galactabeasts - five enormous animals that help them defend Terra Venture from the forces of the evil Scorpius.
Leo adjusts to his responsibilities as a member of the GSA when he forgets to properly lock a weapon storage room on Terra Venture.
A homesick boy who misses Earth helps the Rangers during Furio's sleeping gas attack on Terra Venture.
The shape-changing monster Mutantrum poses as Mike to lure Leo to the legendary Lights of Orion.
Battling the Wisewizard, Kendrix meets an actress on a movie set who looks exactly like her.
Kai is smitten by a pretty girl but has little time for romance as the Quake Maker monster attacks Terra Venture with Earthquakes.
The heroic Magna Defender renews his feud with Scorpius' new general Treacheron.
Seeking vengeance for his son, the Magna Defender battles the Fish Face monster on Terra Venture
Leo and the Magna Defender are forced to work together when the Chillyfish monster freezes the people of Terra Venture.
Kendrix and Maya work to escape from a force field created by the monster Destruxo before he can find the Lights of Orion.
It's a three-way race between the Power Rangers, the Magna Defender, and Destruxo as the Lights of Orion return.
Treacheron turns on Trakeena as the Power Rangers must fight the Shark Brothers without Leo.
The Magna Defender struggles to overcome his regrets of the past while protecting Terra Venture.
Mike returns to Terra Venture and searches for a new role to fight against the Skelekron monster.
Trakeena worries about losing her beauty when her father Scorpius wants her to become a full insect like him.
Commander Stanton sends a boarding party to investigate a derelict spaceship with a dangerous secret.
The treacherous Deviot assists Scorpius by unleashing three lost Galactabeasts to attack Terra Venture.
The Rangers struggle to free the lost Galactabeasts from Deviot.
While Trakeena makes new allies on Onyx, Deviot plots against Scorpius.
Seeking vengeance, Trakeena captures Leo while Deviot plots against her.
Maya's best friend from her home world Shondra arrives on Terra Venture, but Kendrix suspects Shondra may not be who she claims.
Trakeena blackmails Terra Venture into sending their best engineer to repair the Scorpion Stinger's engines.
Kai suspects Commander Stanton is under mind control when he orders Terra Venture steered into the course of a nearby star.
Leo, Damon, and Kai race the Motor Mantis monster on motorcycles, the prize: Kendrix and Maya!
Deviot sends the honorable warrior Loyax to destroy the Rangers, but when he meets Maya he questions the honor in his ways.
Leo struggles to earn the approval of the brother of the girl he wants to date while trying to save her from Trakeena's latest monster.
The Rangers fight the Chameliac Warrior to save their Galactabeasts.
Deviot enlists the Psycho Rangers to capture the Galaxy Rangers, prompting Andros and the Space Rangers to travel to Terra Venture to help.
The Space Rangers and Galaxy Rangers unite to help Kendrix against the Pink Psycho Ranger.
Karone once again assumes the role of Astronema as she risks her life to save the Pink Quasar Saber from falling into the hands of evil.
Karone struggles to overcome her evil past as Astronema while adjusting to being the new Pink Galaxy Ranger.
Damon competes against an unscrupulous rival for the position of head mechanic on Terra Venture.
The Terra Venture discovers the fabled Lost Galaxy
The Rangers are welcomed to the Lost Galaxy by a scheming space pirate named Captain Mutiny.
The Rangers battle the enormous Grunchor monster that has burrowed inside Terra Venture
Captured by Deviot, Leo and Damon reminisce over their adventures up until now.
Captain Mutiny's sorceress Hexuba uses her magic to cause the Power Rangers to fall into a deep restless sleep.
Hexuba uses her magic to resurrect defeated monsters to battle the Power Rangers.
Captain Mutiny unleashes the gargantuan Titanisaur on Terra Venture, the greatest threat the Rangers have faced yet.
Mike sacrifices to help Terra Venture escape the Lost Galaxy.
Terra Venture discovers a lush green planet to colonize as Trakeena merges with Deviot to become stronger than ever.
The Rangers work to evacuate the crew of Terra Venture as Trakeena launches her final assault.
Trapped on a desolate Moon in the ruins of Terra Venture, Leo faces Trakeena all alone.
Five brave young men and women are recruited by the secret agency Lightspeed Rescue to stop a band of demons from destroying Mariner Bay.
The Rangers deploy the Rescue Bird to evacuate people from a burning building while fighting the lava monster Magmavore.
Carter struggles with leading the Rangers in battle as he recalls a traumatic event from his childhood.
The team rushes to help Kelsey's friend Nancy try to land a space shuttle under attack by Diabolico.
Dana is trusted with a special assignment by her father.
The Rangers and Vypra battle it out in new advanced vehicles.
General McKnight tries to replace the Power Rangers with robotic doubles.
Chad faces a dangerous new opponent secretly in league with Vypra.
Dana faces double trouble when the bus she's on is hijacked and a monster causes a volcano to erupt in Mariner Bay.
The Power Rangers attempt to rescue Miss Fairweather from an erupting volcano.
The mysterious Titanium Ranger attacks the Power Rangers.
Captain Mitchell is reunited with his long-lost son.
Ryan does some soul-searching while Diabolico attacks Mariner Bay.
Ryan tries to hide his curse from the team.
Ryan risks life and limb to overcome his curse and help the Rangers battle Diabolico's monsters.
Ryan journeys to an ancient tomb to overcome the curse of the cobra once and for all.
As the Rangers battle Diabolico, the infant Impus finally matures into an even more powerful demon.
Carter finally learns the identity of his boyhood hero.
Olympius conspires with Vypra to allow his mother Queen Bansheera to return to Earth once the planets align.
Lightspeed Rescue tries to stop an asteroid from colliding with the Earth.
The Rangers race to find a crystal before Vypra can use it to power her dangerous new laser.
Chad works to regain the respect of his disappointed martial arts instructor.
Carter is haunted by psychic visions of a future in which the Power Rangers are defeated.
The Rangers hurry to rid themselves of dangerous pods filled with poisonous flowers before they can hatch.
Carter battles to save their frozen teammates.
The Rangers deploy their Mega Battle gear against Olympius and his monster.
Jinxer's plan to unleash a powerful monster on Mariner Bay is thwarted when a thief steals the monster's egg.
Vypra plots to use Chad's love for a mermaid against him.
Trakeena comes to Mariner Bay, prompting the Lost Galaxy Rangers to team up with the Lightspeed Rescue Rangers.
The Lost Galaxy and Lightspeed Rescue Rangers join forces to stop Trakeena from destroying Mariner Bay.
Dana helps her teammates overcome a case of amnesia.
Ryan searches for a sorcerer to help him decrypt an ancient spell to banish Bansheera from Earth again.
Olympius fights to return to Earth while Jinxer hypnotizes Captain Mitchell into draining the Aquabase's power.
Marina warns Chad that Diabolico has stolen her father's magical trident to drain the ocean leaving the Aquabase vulnerable to attack.
The Arachnor monster traps the Rangers in its web forcing Carter to deploy the Trans Armor Cycle: Mega Armor mode.
Dana balances being a glamorous supermodel with her duties as the Pink Ranger.
Bansheera unleashes her magnificent power on friend and foe alike.
Olympius and Diabolico join forces prompting the Rangers to risk using the Lifeforce Megazord powered by their own life energy.
Jinxer launches a crippling attack on the Aquabase.
The Lightspeed Rescue Rangers take their battle against Queen Bansheera into her very lair.
In the year 3000 the evil mutant fugitive Ransik escapes the custody of the elite police force known as Time Force.
Traveling back in time in pursuit of Ransik, the Time Force officers meet the distant ancestor of their former leader.
Wes weighs his privileged lifestyle against the responsibilities of joining the Power Rangers Time Force as the new Red Ranger.
Ransik kidnaps Wes and takes over a television station to announce his evil plans to the world.
31st century champion racecar driver Lucas adjusts to 21st century traffic laws as Trip develops new Vector Cycles for the Rangers.
Ransik hijacks a bus full of school children and Wes' wealthy father refuses to pay the ransom, prompting Wes to reevaluate his place in the family.
Realizing Circuit is the key to the Rangers summoning their Zords, Nadira plots to capture the Rangers' robotic friend.
Jen struggles with her desire to avenge her fallen fiancé when Ransik releases the Fatcatfish.
A mysterious man in the future sends the Rangers a new Zord to help in the fight against Ransik's gang.
Katie worries her actions in the present might be damaging the timeline and erasing events and people she cares about.
Lacking self-confidence, Trip decides he needs to be more like his friends and less like himself.
Wes' dad forms the Silver Guardians, a paramilitary squad to protect the rich from Ransik's gang of mutants.
Silver Guardians member Eric and the Power Rangers race to gain the powers of the Quantum Morpher before Ransik.
Ransik sends a monster back to the time of the dinosaurs to steal the Quantasaurus Rex away from the Quantum Ranger.
While trying to regain control over the Quantasaurus Rex, Eric tries to persuade Mr. Collins to make him the leader of the Silver Guardians.
Lucas protects a young girl from Ransik's gang while the Rangers try to free her kidnapped father.

eps.t: The Legend of the Clock Tower
eps.ov: Katie finds herself in the days of colonial Silver Hills helping a young man find the courage to confess his feelings to the woman he pines over.
Jen and Wes must learn to trust in each other's abilities to rescue their friends.
Trip stands up to Ransik and Eric to protect a peaceful repentant mutant fugitive.
Ransik unfreezes the mutant prisoner Conwing to steal Eric's voice so they can operate the Quantasaurus Rex.
The villainous Contemptra casts a spell of love over the male Rangers to fight each other for her affection.
Nadira unfreezes the criminal racecar driver Dash, former rival of Lucas, to help her launch a crime spree.
Katie tries to persuade a photographer from revealing the secret identities of the Power Rangers.
The heroes are trapped by Ransik's gang in various movie genre dimensions.
The Rangers work to escape various movie genre dimensions.
Ransik releases Jen's former Time Force partner to turn the Pink Ranger evil.
Frax's origin is revealed as he finally has enough of Ransik's abuse.
The time travelers' actions in the present begin to change the future as a previously dead ally from the past returns.
Wes contemplates his destiny as he weighs his duty as the Red Ranger against inheriting his father's company.
Wes refuses to acknowledge the idea of destiny and decides to choose his own path in life.
Jen and Wes go undercover to investigate a shady gym in Silver Hills.
A dark knight from the middle ages travels to the present with a mysterious box.
The Power Rangers Time Force join forces with the Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue to stop Vypra.
The Power Rangers fight to escape a dimension of mirrors full of monsters.
Nadira falls in love with Lucas after reading a love poem he wrote about his car and mistakenly assuming it was written for her.
Circuit's memories are erased by a member of Time Force in the future causing Circuit to doubt his ability to help the Rangers.
Ransik runs out of mutant prisoners to fight for him while Frax prepares to launch his own assault on Silver Hills.
The Rangers receive a chilling warning from the future as Ransik reprograms Frax and Nadira questions her life as a super villainess.
Wes sends the Time Force Rangers back to the future as Frax and his giant robot launch a devastating attack on Silver Hills that no one may survive.
Jen and her teammates disobey orders in order to go back in time to rescue Wes and stop Ransik at any cost.
A young man raised in the jungle travels to the city of Turtle Cove and discovers an island - home to legendary beasts from an ancient civilization - floating in the sky above the city.
Cole seeks to reason with the Orgs while Jindrax and Toxica discover that after 3000 years the Master Org has returned to Earth again.
Cole learns about the secret history of the Animarium while Taylor struggles to accept his leadership.
Danny and Max's close friendship is strained by the return of Danny's old crush.
On a university field trip to some local caves, Alyssa discovers an ancient relic from the Kingdom of Animaria.
Max writes a wish on a note inside a bottle and throws it into Turtle Lake but when the Ship Org appears with the bottle stuck to his body, Max worries others will discover what he wished for.
Taylor helps out two mysterious twin boys while reflecting on how she became the first Wild Force Ranger.
Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord and comes face to face with Master Org, a man he does not remember but has met before.
Master Org's old bodyguard Retinax fights the Power Rangers to restore his lost honor.
The General Org Nayzor unseals an ancient tomb, freeing a cursed warrior with the face of a wolf.
Zen-Aku battles the Rangers with his own evil Wild Zords.
Jindrax and Toxica hijack a bus full of innocents to coerce Max into giving up his Animal Crystal.
Taylor and the Rangers rally to rescue Princess Shayla from Zen-Aku.
Worried that Zen-Aku's memory is returning to him, Nayzor coerces him into attacking the Power Rangers with their own Zords.
The Rangers learn Zen-Aku's true identity and how he became an evil warrior for the Orgs.
The ancient Animarian warrior Merrick fights to atone for his past misdeeds.
The mysterious new Org General Necronomica fights the Rangers while Merrick finds a new home.
Alyssa helps Cole search for information on his long-lost parents while Master Org tries to hide his past from Jindrax and Toxica.
Max tries to regain the respect of his former bowling mentor in order to help him defeat a peculiar new Org.
Danny competes with a wealthy rival for Kendall while preventing the Wedding Dress Org from capturing Turtle Cove's brides to be.
Alyssa must rely on her martial arts heritage when the Rangers come up against Samurai Org.
The especially powerful Tombstone Org tries to send the Rangers six feet under while Merrick and the Princess try to appease the only Zord capable of saving them.
Nayzor returns more powerful than ever requiring the Rangers to quest across time and space to find a new Zord's help.
The Wild Force Rangers join forces with the Silver Guardians to stop three time-traveling monsters from the year 3001.
The Power Ranges Time Force travel back in time to help the Power Rangers Wild Force prevent the three Mut-Orgs from joining forces with Master Org.
Cole learns the truth about his parents when Master Org reveals his sinister origin to the Wild Force Rangers.
Merrick must confront a demon from his past when Zen-Aku returns to claim his soul.
Cole must protect Kite, a young boy alone in the city, as Mandilok, the new Org General, discovers a taste for new buildings.
Princess Shayla and Merrick argue as the Flute Org's music ruins their song, causing the Rangers to dance uncontrollably.
While Max and Taylor help Kite look for his home, they are attacked by Jindrax and his brother Juggelo at an amusement park.
The Lion Tamer Org takes control of the Wild Zords and turns them against the Rangers.
Kite finally remembers his past as he grows dissatisfied with mankind's disregard for nature.
Without Princess Shayla or the Wild Zords, the Rangers still refuse to give up in their fight to save the world.
Ten Red Rangers from ten different teams unite to stop the Machine Empire from using Serpenterra to destroy Earth.
The Duke Org Onikage arrives in the Nexus with a plan to infiltrate the Rangers' Animarium and capture Princess Shayla.
The Power Rangers fight across dimensions to try and rescue Princess Shayla from the returning Master Org.
The Rangers receive help from an unlikely source in their battle against the powerful Locomotive Org, as Jindrax plots to bring back his friend.
Jindrax and Toxica team up with the Rangers in order to rescue the Princess and destroy the Nexus once and for all.

eps.t: The End of the Power Rangers (1)
eps.ov: With no more villains to fight, the Rangers realize that their time as super heroes is finally at an end. Meanwhile, in the remains of the Nexus, a new threat emerges to threaten the Earth and the Animarium.

eps.t: The End of the Power Rangers (2)
eps.ov: Master Org's destruction of nature continues unchecked while the Power Rangers fight a last desperate battle for the Earth. Good and evil collide in a final battle between the forces of Animaria and the Orgs.

When all the Ninja Academies in the world are destroyed by Lothor, only three young students, Shane, Tori and Dustin are not captured. Their Sensei gives them the powers to become the Wind Ninja Power Rangers and the daunting mission of saving the world.
When Shane decides to take on the Mad Magnet monster by himself, he learns that it takes teamwork and trust to overcome obstacles and maintain friendships.
When Lothor's minions appeal to Tori's vanity, they lure her to a photo shoot then create her doppelganger to help them infiltrate the Ninja Ops.
The others question Dustin's commitment to the Rangers when it seems he is spending too much time with his new motocross buddies, Blake and Hunter.
The Thunder Rangers use the Tsunami Cycles and their Thunder Megazord to try and defeat the Wind Rangers.
The Amphibidor monster tries to drain the city dry. Hunter and Blake reveal that they are the Thunder Rangers.
When Hunter and Blake meet the ghosts of their parents in the Cavern of Lost Ninjas they learn that Lothor is responsible for their parents' deaths, not Sensei.
The Power Rangers defend the city against Florabundacus, an evil monster who tries to destroy the world with carnivorous plants.
Hunter and Blake are fooled by Choobo, who erases their memories and pits them against the Wind Rangers.
All of the Rangers are transported to a sinking island where they battle each other.
Blake and the Wind Rangers must find a way to break Choobo's spell over Hunter.
Choobo takes his last stand against the Power Rangers.
Marah and Kapri send their alien boxing instructor, the Boxing Bopp-a-roo, to disrupt the Total Trek race that Shane and Hunter are running to prove who is more macho.
The Power Rangers fight against Trayf, the Pig Monster, who traps them in his nightmare world.
Cam and his father quarrel because the Sensei is overprotective. Madtropolis drains the Rangers of their powers forcing Cam to go back to the past for a mysterious power source.
Cam travels back in time to the Wind Ninja Academy to gain the powers he needs to become the Green Ranger and to save the younger versions of his parents from the menace of his evil uncle, Lothor.
Lothor seeks revenge on Cam by sending five monsters at once to destroy the city.
Cam's weird behavior comes at a bad time when Fragra captures two of the Rangers in perfume bottles.
In an attempt to win over the hearts and minds of the Earth, Lothor and Mr. Ratwell produce a sitcom and administer a love potion.
Hunter mentors a kid who happens to acquire Lothor's Personal Alien Manager; the teens are excited about an action sports video contest.
Marah convinces Dustin that she wants to become a good person when she is replaced in the Lair by her friend Beevil.
In an attempt to make his father human again, Cam builds a machine that accidentally turns Sensei into Shane - leaving Shane a guinea pig.
Dustin lets a bit of fame go to his head. Meanwhile, the Slob Goblin monster attacks the city, turning people into stamps.
A mild-mannered mechanic turns into a mutant creature that wants Crimson Ranger's power for a bizarre experiment.
A benevolent alien comes to Earth searching for a Red Power Ranger, while Sensei sends Shane on a life journey.
Shane receives a powerful gift from Skyla, while the Rangers continue to fight Zurgane Zord.
As the teens prepare for a televised talent show, Motodrone brings to life Shimazu and the three Wolfblades.
Cam must use all the Rangers' power disks to summon a new weapon strong enough to defeat Wolfblades.
When Lothor tries to use the Snipster to break up an international peace conference, the Power Rangers must use their inner ninja skill, and a new weapon, to cut the Snipster down to size.
Tori finds herself in a bizarre dimension where everything is the opposite of what she knows.
Blake secretly trains with a new weapon that is tested when the Inflatron monster attacks.
Shane is worried when his judgmental older brother comes to visit. The Eyezak monster makes the Rangers see their greatest fears.
The guys' plans to go camping are interrupted when Zurgane decides to defeat the Rangers on his own.
Zurgane makes a last attempt to defeat the Rangers.
Cam uses the Gem of Souls to power a new vehicle.
Marah and Kapri team up with Shimazu and attack in evil Zords. Blake and Hunter get in an argument.
Lothor begins his ultimate plan to take over the Earth.
The Rangers must stop Lothor from opening the Abyss of Evil.
When Mesogog, an evil scientist, unleashes Bio Zords on the city, former Power Ranger Tommy Oliver recruits three high school kids to become Power Rangers and tame the beasts.
When Mesogog releases his Bio Zords on the city, Tommy has no choice but to give three teens Dino Morphers to turn them into Power Rangers.
Conner is given a shot at playing professional soccer, but his Ranger duties impede upon this once in a lifetime chance. Will he give up helping to save the world for a sports career?
As Tommy is held captive by Mesogog, the teens work with Hayley to attempt to rescue him.

Utilizing Hayley's help, and their new Raptor Cycles, the Dino Thunder Rangers storm the island base on a mission to rescue Tommy from Mesogog's clutches. Will they get there before the Black Dino Gem falls into evil's hands?
Kira's old singing partner, the now famous Kylee Styles comes to town, just as Mesogo releases the Donkeyvac monster, who sucks the youth from people and turns them old.
Ethan is zapped into a video game.
As Trent's father purchases the Café and threatens to fire Hayley to put Trent in charge, Zeltrax releases a new creation to destroy the Rangers.
A new Dinozord Egg is uncovered by the Rangers during a class archeological dig, but Tyranodrones interfere, allowing Elsa to snag the Egg first.

When famous actress Nikki Valentine is captured by Mesogog to be used as a part of his evil schemes, the Rangers must save her and face off against Mesogog's newest monster named Megaldor. Meanwhile, Hayley uncovers a new Dino Egg, which hatches into the Stego Zord.
Trent accidentally bonds with the White Dino Gem, and becomes the White Dino Thunder Ranger.
The evil White Ranger finds his own Dragozord Dino Egg, and begins to bond it to him by feeding it energy from his Morpher.
Tommy discovers the identity of the White Ranger.
Realizing he is the White Ranger, Trent quits his job in an attempt to protect his friends.
A strange meteorite lands in the forest, and it's effects brings out repressed personality traits in anyone it comes in contact with.
Tommy, now freed from the amber, discovers he can't demorph from the form of Black Ranger.
While helping Tommy clean up his lab, Kira stumbles onto a secret bone.
A school bully sets his sights on Ethan. Meanwhile, Tommy discovers the true identity of Zeltrax.

When Conner, Ethan, and Kira find a show about Power Rangers in Japan, Conner is appalled at its portrayal of them. Meanwhile, the Japanese Rangers must go up against a money hungry monster named Ka-Ching.
When Kira lands a new job as an intern on the Funky Fisherman cartoon show, Cassidy is dismayed to discover she was passed over.
As Anton Mercer explains to Trent that Mesogog was an experiment gone horribly wrong, Zeltrax creates the Copyotter to attack the city.

Zeltrax samples a portion of the new Evil White Ranger clone's energy, and creates the White Terrorsaurus monster. With it, and the clone, he helps confuse the Power Rangers about their newest team member's loyalty.
Kira is conflicted when the manager who wants to shoot a music video with her, but wants her to compromise her own style.
While Elsa works on her plan to shoot a powerful laser beam at Jupiter, Kira and Ethan help Cassidy land a job at the TV station.

Ethan takes an interest in deciphering the hieroglyphics of Egyptian ruler Tutenhawken, but not only jinxes himself, causing chaos at his every step, but frees the ancient evil from his multi-millenna-long slumber.
To help her mutant flower grow into the Thornox monster, Elsa uses a sample of a mysterious green slime. Meanwhile, Tommy attempts to use the same slime to demorph.

Tommy's invisibility problem is solved, but as a result, his Dino Gem is shattered and he ends up in a coma! Lying in a hospital bed, he faces his greatest battle, as he confronts three of his previous Power Ranger powers in a fevered test of willpower.
Conner gets involved with an environmentalist campaign to save a hundred year old tree, all so he can impress a girl named Krista.

Ethan's overly confident and downright cocky attitude concerning his skills at playing the "Detonation Man" computer game begins to get on everyone's nerves. Meanwhile, Volcanologist Dr. Morton gets turned into a Horn-Rimmed Monster by Elsa.

As Mesogog and Anton Mercer battle for control, a fluctuation in the Morphing Grid forces the White Ranger and his evil clone to meet in a final battle. Meanwhile, the other Rangers do battle with Mesogog's Jade Gladiator.
When the Abyss of Evil is opened, Lothor returns and casts a spell on Shane, Tori, and Dustin, turning them evil and setting them loose on Reefside.
In an attempt to help Shane, Tori, and Dustin, Cam goes to the Abyss of Evil with Hunter and Blake to retrieve the Power Coins.
Elsa invades the Rangers dreams in order to destroy them for good. With each Ranger facing off against a unique monster, will they be able to overcome their fears?
Trent is given a magical pen, and accidentally pulls the Rangers into his comic book.
The Rangers discover the identities of Elsa and Mesogog.
Conner, Kira, and Ethan reminisce about how their lives have changed after becoming Power Rangers.
Trent cuts a deal with Mesogog to spare Anton's life.
As Tommy rushes to rescue Elsa from Zeltrax, the Rangers stage one last final battle against Mesogog.
Two street kids are pursued by the S.P.D., a space patrol from the future whose job it is to protect Earth from evil aliens.
Jack and Z must decide whether or not to join the S.P.D. Emperor Gruumm sets his sights on Earth.
Jack lets being the leader go to his head. Gruumm lures the A Squad Rangers into space.
Sky's refusal to accept Jack as the leader of the Rangers results in a victory for Gruumm.
Syd is the only one that believes R.I.C., the robotic dog, can still be a valuable asset to S.P.D.
The other Rangers are skeptical of Bridge's unusual investigative methods.
Mora uses a young boy with special powers in a plot to capture people and turn them into dolls.
Z befriends Sam, and teaches him to use his special powers for the good of mankind.
Sky's loyalty to an old friend is put to the test when it is suspected that he is working for Gruumm.
Syd is angry with Jack when she makes him work on her birthday.
Cruger must face the demons of his past when an old enemy returns.
Cruger is challenged by an old foe and must overcome his reluctance to fight.
Cruger refuses to help the Rangers fight Dracel; Gruumm goes after the Stone of Evil.
A new recruit has SPD buzzing; Gruumm looks for a second in command.
The teens must find Sophie before Valko uses her to control Gorodon.
Trouble results when Boom tells his visiting parents that he is a Power Ranger.
A dangerous alien criminal switches bodies with Sky.
Gruumm brings a noble warrior from the past and tricks him into battling the Rangers.
Cruger is relieved from duty when he clashes with the tough SPD Supreme Commander.
The Rangers relate the capture of a criminal to Cruger, but they all have their own unique version of the story.
The cadets get a message from the future that today is the day that they will lose the battle of Earth to the Troobians.
A mysterious Ranger from the future comes to help the Rangers in their hour of need.
Morgana grants real power to a washed-up magician in her latest attempt to destroy the Rangers.
Sky must interrogate a notorious criminal when aliens that SPD has already captured attack the Rangers.
Sky must face off with the criminal who was responsible for the loss of his father.
Piggy and friends steal SPD technology; the Rangers are sent to Zentor to train for SWAT mode.
Under the command of a tough drill sergeant, the Rangers must learn to work as a team before they can earn a powerful new weapons' technology.
The Rangers nearly reach their breaking point when both Gruumm and Broodwing send robot after robot to attack the city.
Jack and Sky embark on a dangerous mission to stop an incoming meteor from destroying Earth.
Convinced that the Rangers no longer need her, Kat takes a top-level position at SPD Headquarters.
Bridge is captured and the other Rangers must use all their skills to find him before he is destroyed.
Broodwing brings the Dino Rangers from the past to fight on the side of evil.
Cruger's old rival teams up with Broodwing to take down the Rangers one by one.
The teens grapple with failure after Cruger hails the A squad.
Jack needs to decide what he really wants to do with his life and the Rangers are dealt a shocking revelation.
With Cruger captured, the A Squad is sent by Gruumm to finish off the Rangers.
Omni descends to Earth and Gruumm makes his last stand against the Rangers.
Gruumm takes The Terror to the past in an attempt to defeat Earth before SPD was formed.
A spell has been broken and evil is emerging to destroy the Earth.
Xander, Vida, Chip and Madison finally tap into their Mystic Force powers. But without a Red Ranger, Udonna and Clare know they are in trouble.
Chip and Vida think they can learn more spell codes by doing community service, but learn that real heroes are born in the face of danger.
Nick thinks Madison is too shy. When she gets turned to stone, Nick finds out he's wrong.
The others think Nick stole some money. Nick hears voices in his head and finds out its Koragg.
While in battle, Nick is whisked away with Catastros to another dimension. He must face his fears of Catastros.
Xander thinks he knows how to be a leader. When it comes to getting the Fire Heart before Necrolai, Xander has to follow in order to lead.
DJ Fly, a new DJ, comes to town. Chip finds out that DJ Fly is turning the teens of Briarwood into vampires.
Fly Trap has been destroyed, but Vida is still a vampire. The Rangers find out that Necrolai is the vampire who bit Vida.

Xander has a big zit. He thinks he can get rid of it by using a perfection potion. Instead Xander starts turning into a tree. Vida has to help Xander and then the Rangers have to protect and figure out the secret of the Fire Heart.
Clare takes on the legacy of her mother as the Gatekeeper. Koragg captures Udonna.
The gates have been raised and Morticon is set free. Nick goes to save Clare while the others hold off Morticon.
Necrolai gets the Rangers to break the force field of a magical cave. Inside the cave is a magical lamp and a petrified mummy. Jenji is found inside the lamp. Imperious is brought to life by Octomus.
Imperious turns into Calindor and tries to persuade Udonna into believing he can help Mystic Force. The Rangers are busy trying to fight Jester.
Daggeron teaches Xander that without practice, he can cause harm to the rest of the Rangers. Daggeron sends the teens to Shalifar to help Xander see the meaning of inner strength.

Koragg decides it's time to fight Solaris Knight. Gnatu steals life force from civilians when the Rangers come to stop him. Chip accidentally stumbles upon a soul specter as they battle Gnatu. Daggeron must save Chip from the soul specter while battling Koragg.
Jenji gets jealous of Fire Heart. He takes Fire Heart to live in the forest. When he goes back to find him, Fire Heart is gone.
The Rangers get lazy and use their magic for everything. When fighting becomes too tiring for them, the Rangers want to use Jenji.
Imperious has wished the Power Rangers away. The world has lost its color and evil now rules.
The Tribunal of Magic has turned down the teens' request to restore things to the way they were.
Imperious makes Koragg stand trial for his countless failures. In the end, Koragg argues that he fights with honor.
Daggeron and Udonna finally tell the Rangers the full story of the Great War.
Koragg was really Leanbow all this time. Nick finds out he's really Leanbow and Udonna's son.
With Udonna gone, Mystic Force faces a new terror. 10 Terrors rise against the Rangers. Magma is the first Terror the Rangers must face.
Oculus is chosen to capture the Light. He is able to take all the other Rangers down one by one. In order to defeat him, Nick must learn to connect with Fire Heart.
Nick & Vida keep arguing. Hekatoid slimes them so they can't morph. As stubborn as they are, they need to learn to work together in order to save the others from Serpentina.
Leanbow is stopping the Master from rising and Sculpin has a plan to stop him. The Snow Prince commands that instead of being teacher, Daggeron should take a lesson from Nick on following his gut.
Hekatoid has captured Udonna and the Rangers chase after him in his own dimension to rescue her. Daggeron, in the real world, tries to stop all the tadpoles Hekatoid has laid to destroy the world.
The teens lose their powers trying to save Udonna.
Matoombo is chosen to bring forth the Master. But Matoombo doesn't want to hurt anyone. Vida teams up with him to try to seal the Master away forever.
Itassis doesn't want to fight for the Master anymore and defies his wishes. The Master takes matters into his own hands and destroys Mystic Mother.

In the final confrontation with The Master, the Mystic Force has suffered great losses. With Daggeron and Leanbow defeated, the Rangers must use all their magic to try and save both the Surface World and the Magical Realm.
Billionaire treasure hunter Andrew Hartford finds the ancient Corona Aurora. But in the process, he unknowingly awakens two warring alien brothers.
Hartford is kidnapped by Moltor, who also steals the Corona Aurora. Mack must prove himself as the Red Ranger and aid the team in saving his father.
Will's self-reliance causes friction within the team. The Rangers seek one of the Corona Aurora gems in the underwater ruins of Atlantis.
Dax rescues a girl named Mira from a monster attack and they quickly become a couple.
After putting a bystander in jeopardy, Mack doesn't feel he's cut out to be a Ranger.
Searching the island of St. Lucia for the first jewel of the Corona Aurora, the Rangers stumble upon the ghost of Brownbeard, the pirate.
Ronny's competitive nature begins to annoy her teammates. Will things get worse when she butts heads with Mack over first usage of the latest weapon?
Will is fired by Hartford for selling Zord tech on the side! Taking his Tracker with him, the Black Ranger joins up with Miratrix.
Flurious and Moltor put aside their sibling rivalry and combine forces against the Rangers.
Dax gets his big break as an actor, but Mr. Hartford refuses to allow him to take the role, since it may conflict with his Ranger duties.
The Rangers visit Rose's college in London to try to get the parchment deciphered, only to lose it to Tyzonn, Moltor's latest alien lizard henchman.
Mack joins forces with Tyzonn, learning that the reptilian creature is actually a human from the planet Mercury, cursed by Moltor.
The search for the next jewel leads the Rangers to Portugal and then to Brazil, with a new group of villains always one step ahead of them!
It's up to Mr. Hartford to restore the liquidized Tyzonn to his human form.
Tyzonn gets trapped between his human and mercury forms! Can he be saved in time to aid the Rangers against the Giant Robot-piloting Fearcats?
Will attempts to teach Tyzonn how to blend in on Earth, but when the Mercurian starts to copy Will a little too closely, they clash.
With the Cannon of Ki Amuk and Mjolnir in their possession, the Rangers track the next clue to Mexico.
Having swiped the Paedra Aztec Del Compass from the Rangers, Moltor puts it in the possession of his old friend Blothgaar.
Using the compass, the Rangers finally find the Third Jewel of the Corona Aurora.
The son of Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa, Thrax, unites all four Corona Aurora-seeking factions of villains into a new Evil Alliance.
No longer having Ranger powers, the former Overdrive Rangers return to their civilian lives.
The Rangers get a day off and plan a relaxing picnic in the forest. Unfortunately for Rose, Tyzonn is obsessed with getting to know her better.
Ronny runs into a stubborn obstacle named Will while trying to throw a Halloween party.
Norg and Will strike up a strange alliance in their attempt to find the Fearcats' secret hideout.
While battling one of Kamdor's monsters, the Rangers get their computer systems infected with a virus.
After learning about his true robotic nature, Mack starts to go through an identity crisis.
Mig and Benglo utilize the power of the Octavian Chalice and unleash the mighty Agrios, a giant robotic creature.
While the other Rangers continue to be outmatched by the Fearcats and Agrios, Tyzonn begins to accept his fiancée's claims that he never was a Ranger.
Using Mack's internal CPU to review their Ranger careers, the team takes the time to refresh their memories as to who has which Corona Aurora jewel.
Using the Octavian Chalice, the Rangers journey to Greece in an attempt to find the next jewel via an ancient ritual.
The Rangers return to Egypt and then travel to Japan in their heated quest to find the key to unlock the last hidden jewel.
With the ultimate power of the completed Corona Aurora at his disposal, Flurious freezes all of San Angeles and prepares to conquer the world.
Theo, Lily and rookie Casey are chosen to become the latest guardians of Dai Shi, an ancient imprisoned spirit.
With Mantor still plaguing the city, the Rangers are in desperate need of learning the ability to bring themselves up to his size.
Casey requests extra training from RJ, the spirit of the buffalo is harnessed for evil, and Fran protects the pizza parlor from a children's party.
The Five Fingers of Poison are brought forth by Dai Shi, who doubly stuns the Rangers by finally revealing his human form to be the face of Jarrod.
The second Finger of Poison, Gakko, uses his wall-sticking skills to humiliate the Rangers when they try to face him on his own turf.
The friendship between Theo and Lily is tested by the Yellow Ranger's budding platonic relationship with Casey.
With RJ out of town, Casey is left in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza. Instead of asserting himself as the boss, he creates chaos in the pizza parlor.
The heavily armored Pangolin proves to be too tough of a nut for the Rangers to crack. Their only hope is a powerful weapon called the Jungle Mace.
Casey loses his $5 tip to a young boy named Josh, who wants to buy himself a kite.
Theo spreads his focus too thin, leading his teammates to question his effectiveness in battle. Blind Master Swoop teaches him Bat Spirit techniques.
Believing that Carnisoar's training methods are too harsh, Camille decides to find him a new master and revives Jellica, the Sea Overlord.
Casey anxiously awaits the arrival of his second master, but RJ begins to feel forgotten as a result.
After another victorious battle against Camille's monsters, the Rangers feel they are unstoppable. But RJ warns them about being overconfident.
With RJ captured, the Rangers must travel to the spirit world to find the last three remaining masters.
Everyone makes fun of Lily for being too nice. Lily gets fed up and starts to show her bad side, refusing to help the other Rangers.
After his last battle, RJ has major problems controlling his animal spirit. He turns into a werewolf and becomes a big threat to anyone around him.
Casey really has grown and stepped up to being the leader of the group. But now, with RJ as a Ranger, Casey feels like a cub all over again.
Grizzaka sends an evil spirit to cause trouble between RJ and his animal spirit again. The hero in RJ causes him to save Flit.
Dominic was sent out by Master Mao to find purpose for his life. He finds out that RJ and the others are Power Rangers and he wants to join them.
Jarrod has found the Rhino Nexus. Dominic is startled by a dream telling him to protect the Control Dagger, as it holds the key to his destiny.
The Overlords won't grant the Nexus to the Rangers. Yet, having searched all his life for his destiny, Dominic won't let them stand in his way.
The Phantom Beasts were a notorious force in the Beast Wars. The crystal eyes hold the power to bring back these Phantom Beasts.
The Phantom Beasts have been brought back to life. Dai Shi has them prove their loyalty by capturing the three masters.
The Phantom Beasts call forth the Spirit Rangers, who look and fight exactly like Power Rangers. Our heroes are in for a real fight!
To stop the Spirit Rangers, RJ risks destroying his father. Trusting his instincts, he finds that his dad was prepared if this should happen.
The Rangers get sucked into a cheesy game show about the past season. Camille hosts the game show and a wrong answer could result in being canceled!
Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King. Weakened with the loss of his spirit, Casey must summon all the energy he has left to stay alive.
Whiger was only able to steal the Tiger Spirit from Casey, but not destroy Casey. For his failure, Dai Shi strips him of his power.
Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl. The monkeys duplicate and Camille's plan just might work, but Scorch and Snapper sabotage her plan.
The day has arrived for the three to get their master stripes. Lily and Theo pass the test to become masters. Casey does not.
Nobody believes him, but Casey knows that Jarrod still lives inside of Dai Shi. He goes off on his own to save Jarrod.
A new war is about to begin as Dai Shi opens a vortex and resurrects all his fallen warriors. Outnumbered, the Rangers do their best to battle evil.
The Venjix computer network is laying ruin to the entire planet, and the human race has retreated into the environmentally shielded city of Corinth.
As Venjix grows stronger, it becomes clear that the Rangers need more than three operators to defend the city.
Dillon goes through a series of tests to see if he even is Ranger material, but the real test comes when he is faced with the choice of seeking out his past or helping the Rangers as promised.
When Ziggy is charged with finding the new Green Ranger, he finds the perfect candidate in Tenaya 7, until he realizes she's a machine working for Venjix!
When Dillon struggles to activate the invincibility mode of his suit, he challenges Dr. K to come out from behind their protective screen.
Ziggy's recruitment as Ranger Green is put into question when parts of his shady past are revealed. Should the Rangers work with someone who is hated by all seven of Corinth's cartels?
Scott is flooded with memories of his brother when he returns to Marcus' crash site in order to retrieve an over thruster core the Rangers need for the new Megazord configuration.
Mr. and Mrs. Landsdown suddenly reappear in Summer's life, intent on making their daughter live up to her promise to marry into a wealthy family.
Diamonds and pretty dresses are no longer important to Summer, who finds her true meaning in what she does with the Rangers.
All his life, all Flynn ever wanted to do was to help people, but his heroics as the Blue Ranger are cut short when there is a malfunction in his suit.
While attempting to overcome a power problem with the Rangers' new Zord configuration, Doctor K is haunted by a terrible mistake.
When Venjix sends an attack bot from Dillon's past to infiltrate the city, Dillon is torn between destroying the bot, or finally finding the answers to his past.
As the Venjix Virus comes closer to taking over Dillon entirely, the other Rangers and Dr. K race to find a way to slow the growth rate of the virus.
Seeking answers to Dillon's past, the Rangers go outside Corinth to a place Dillon thinks he remembers, unaware that it's a trap set by Venjix himself.
The Rangers once again find themselves saved by the Gold and Silver Rangers.
As the Rangers take a more offensive approach against Venjix, the virus traps the citizens of Corinth inside their own dome and proceeds to suck all the air out of the city.
Dillon discovers that his sister might be a prison in the same factory where Gem & Gemma were once held prisoner by Venjix.
The Rangers learn they must return to the factory and destroy the Venjix Doomsday Box that is being built.
When Gem & Gemma's spontaneous antics nearly get them caught in a trap, they realize that they must work together as a team with the other Rangers.
In an effort to impress his father, Scott makes a reckless trip out to the wasteland.
With their resources dangerously low, Dr. K has to trust the untested technology of the WheelZord to try and destroy the latest attack bot.
When an Attack Bot puts all of Corinth's men to sleep, it is up to the girls to suit up and defend Corinth.
For the first time ever, join Ziggy as he takes you behind the scenes of the Power Rangers.
Truman discovers that Dr. K was responsible for creating the Venjix Virus.
When Dillon discovers that the two keys to his watch fit together to play another song, he uses it to try to reach Tenaya 7.
Dillon is betrayed after he and Tenaya 7 break into the Venjix Palace to retrieve codes that are needed to stop an attack bot.
Dillon's search for Tenaya is put on hold when Scott is shot with a key that allows Shifter to control him.
Ziggy must pay back the $5 million he owes Fresno Bob.
Ziggy accidentally teleports himself and Dr. K into a cave.
Dillon fears the virus will take him over.
When the magnetic blast goes off and all the electricity goes out in Corinth, Venjix moves to take the city.
The Rangers race to insert a virus into Venjix before he takes over Corinth.
Mike figures out the hard way what it means to be a Samurai Ranger after a Nighlok attacks him and his friends.
The Rangers step in when a devious Nighlok tricks a young boy into giving up on his baseball dreams.
Struggling to master a secret power disc, Jayden foregoes a trip with the others to an amusement park where the rest of the team encounters the evil Nighlok Dreadhead.

When a Nighlok who uses insults as a physical weapon attacks the Rangers, only Emily is unaffected. To help her teammates, she explains how difficult events in life become an opportunity to grow stronger.
Kevin is assigned the crucial task of catching the elusive SwordfishZord in order to save the other Rangers who have been incapacitated by the stench of the Nighlok Yamiror's breath.
Dayu crosses into the mortal world to cause misery by kidnapping brides on their wedding day.

eps.t: I've Got a Spell on Blue
eps.ov: A Nighlok uses mind control powers to force Kevin to fight against his fellow Rangers.
After Mike goes rogue in battle, Mentor takes Mike's Samuraizer away until he learns a deeper lesson about the nature of the Green Ranger's Symbol Power.
A Nighlok is sent to stop the Red Ranger from using his special power to seal Master Xandred in the Netherworld forever, but their duel is interrupted by the mysterious Deker.

Jayden leaves the Shiba house hoping to keep the other Rangers out of harm's way, but when a powerful Nighlok attacks, Jayden finally accepts the fact that he needs his team to fulfill his role as the leader of the Samurai Rangers.
A traveling fisherman named Antonio arrives and claims to be the sixth Samurai Ranger.
Jayden's childhood friend and self-made Samurai Antonio struggles to be accepted by the team as the Gold Ranger.
As Antonio attempts to gain Kevin's respect as a true Samurai, Octoroo devises a plan to create a stronger portal between the Netherworld and Earth via a secret ancient well.
The Rangers must defeat the evil Splitface who steals people's spirits including the Yellow Rangers before they fall into an eternal sleep.
Jayden is poisoned by Octoroo during his attempt to discover the Red Ranger's sealing symbol, which can lock away Master Xandred forever.
With Jayden kidnapped by Deker, the other Rangers must summon the strength to fight a mutant Nighlok without their leader.
When the Gold and Pink Ranger fall under the spell of a dream-inducing Nighlok, the other Rangers must enter the Dream World to save them.
The Rangers try to finish off the dream monster Rhinosnorus while Jayden and Deker finally face off in their ultimate duel.
As invasions from the Netherworld increase, the Red Ranger unites a new team of Samurai Rangers to meet the rising threat.
