As the teens continue their transition into their new secret lives as Samurai Rangers, Emily reveals a surprising truth about herself.

Halloween is every Nighlok's favorite day of the year so the creepiest creatures from the Netherworld are just dying to get into the scariest party ever and trade war stories about their battles with the Samurai Power Rangers.
The Samurai Rangers team up with the mysterious RPM Ranger Red to fight off dual threats from Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic supervillain from the RPM Ranger's dimension.
Twas the night before Christmas and all through the Shiba House the teens reflect on their first year together as a team and as friends.

The Rangers discover that cracks in the earth are now allowing pools of Sanzu River water to seep into our world from the Netherworld and that a mutated Nighlok is using the evil water to keep from drying out as it wreaks havoc throughout the city.

The Rangers struggle to find a way to defeat a Nighlok with an apparently indestructible shell without the help of Antonio, who has unknowingly lost his Samurai Morpher and cannot be reached. Meanwhile, Bulk and Spike find Antonio's Morpher, but think it's a phone that they must return to the original owner.

It's mixed-up mayhem when the Rangers encounter Switchbeast, a Nighlok who can trap people's spirits inside common objects. When the monster does this to four of the Rangers, Mike and Emily must figure out how to defeat him on their own.

After Antonio develops an unusual fear of fish that leaves him unable to be the Gold Ranger, his teammates rally to help him overcome it. Meanwhile, a mysterious and powerful new enemy arrives to help Master Xandred in his quest to flood the earth.
Octoroo, with the help of the Nighlok Eyescar, kidnaps Antonio and Mentor to use as bait in order to lead the rest of the Rangers into a Mooger trap.

A daring boy named Cody unlocks an ancient seal, releasing an enormous BullZord, the very first Samurai Zord, which rampages across the countryside. The Power Rangers must fight to save the city by capturing the beast and taming it to serve as their newest Megazord.

eps.t: He Ain't Heavy Metal, He's My Brother
eps.ov: When Mia's younger brother comes to town to try and convince her to sing lead in his band, the reunion is anything but sweet music. Meanwhile, Serrator once again attacks the city.

When a Nighlok eats his Samuraizer, Kevin is unable to help the team defeat the beast, at the same time that he is missing his old life as a competitive swimmer. Meanwhile, Dayu and Deker make a deal with the evil Serrator.

While the Rangers battle a crafty Nighlok who creates mirror images of himself to confuse them, Spike realizes that one of the duties of being a Samurai is to share in the responsibilities of day-to-day life and sets off to find a job so he can help pay the rent on his Uncle Bulk's clubhouse.

eps.t: The Strange Case of the Munchies
eps.ov: Emily has a crisis in confidence, just as the other Rangers are affected by a Nighlok's evil black sand, which sends them into a desperate hunger/thirst mode. While Emily and Mentor Ji struggle to manage the hungry Rangers and defeat the Nighlok, Bulk and Spike find Mia's wallet and head to the Shiba House to return it.

After a Nighlok glues their hands together, Kevin and Mike learn that working as a team doesn't just mean sharing their strengths; it's knowing when they need to ask for help with their weaknesses as well.

Serrator takes the first step in his mysterious master plan to seize the earth by clouding the minds of the people of the island Monalua, spreading paranoia throughout the residents. To stop Serrator, the Rangers will need a special new weapon, the Bullzooka!

As Jayden struggles with his sudden doubts on whether or not he has what it takes to be the Red Ranger, Master Xandred demands Serrator return Dayu's Harmonium, prompting Serrator to reveal his true intentions.
The Rangers discover that Serrator's recent attacks have an ulterior motive -- to crack open the earth and let the Sanzu flood it and thereby become ruler of both worlds.
Halloween gets spooktacular when an evil Nighlok invades the Samurai Rangers' dreams and turns them into nightmares.
When Serrator asks Deker to fulfill the final piece of his destructive plans, Antonio begs Deker to reconsider his role in the battle between humans and the Nighlok.

The Nighlok Fiera unleashes an overwhelming attack on the Red Ranger, but when he goes down another Red Ranger takes his place. Which one is the real Red Ranger? The answer will change the Samurai Rangers forever.
As the Rangers attempt to adjust to being led by a new Red Ranger, Jayden struggles to find new meaning in his life.
Jayden finishes his grand battle against Deker and the other Rangers try to convince him to rejoin their team before Master Xandred reawakens.

With Master Xandred back on Earth, the Rangers finally attempt to use the Sealing Symbol to stop him - only to discover that he has a special new defense against it. Now, they must rise to the challenge and find a new way to defeat him and save the world.
In a climactic battle, the Rangers face off against Master Xandred for the last time.
The Samurai Rangers get stuck in the Megazord's cockpit on Christmas Eve when it breaks down after battling a Nighlok. Will they be able to make it out in time to celebrate Christmas?
When malicious aliens make their way to Earth's orbit, Gosei decides to form a new team of teenage heroes to defend the planet and carry on the proud tradition of the Power Rangers.
The alien invaders send Scaraba, an alien scientist, down to Earth to study the human race. Meanwhile, Troy finds himself face-to-face with Creepox.
When Noah has trouble lifting Jake's heavy weapon, he begins to doubt his abilities, until he learns that believing in yourself is all that's necessary to get any job done.
As the Rangers learn that concentration is essential to perfecting their Ranger skills, they are distracted by a civilian falsely claiming to be a Ranger.
Best Friends Gia and Emma are turned into bitter enemies by a vicious monster, Beezara. Meanwhile, the guys are captured by Beezara and turned into her slaves.
When Dizchord attacks the city with music that produces physical pain, the Rangers must fight back in an unorthodox way with a song of their own.
After Troy deals with some small-minded bullies at school, the Rangers square off against a more dangerous bully, Creepox.
The mysterious Robo Knight joins the Power Rangers. Can he help them defeat toxic monsters that threaten the Earth?
While the Rangers are unsure about how to work with the newly-arrived Robo Knight, Vrak captures the robotic Ranger in an attempt to reprogram him for his own nefarious purposes.
When a shadow-stealing monster attacks, the Rangers must teach Robo Knight the power of teamwork in order to defeat him.
The Megaforce Rangers must find a powerful ancient weapon called the Wild Sword in the Black Mountains. Vrak plans to get to the sword first where he enlist the help of Distractor.
Gia, Emma, Troy, and Jake are captured by Nojoke during his capture of laughing people. Noah and Robo Knight must overcome their differences to free the captive Rangers and defeat Nojoke.

A dream-eating monster called Dream Snatcher preys on Emma after being enhanced by the Aurora Box that belonged to Vrak's family. The Rangers and Robo Knight must rescue Emma's dreams and defeat Dream Snatcher before the Roots of Despair emitted from his victims rot the Earth.
Gosei and the Rangers must work together to defeat Bluefur and Bigs when they use the power of the Aurora Box.
The Rangers have a strange encounter with a medium on Halloween.
The Megaforce Rangers encounter their first Robotic opponents, who try to convince Robo Knight that humans are the true danger to the Earth.
When one of Metal Alice's robots malfunctions, Emma and the Power Rangers decide to adopt it and teach it the values of friendship and freedom.

The Megaforce Rangers must race to save the day when Metal Alice plots to throw the city into chaos by derailing a passenger train. Meanwhile, Robo Knight comes closer to understanding humans when he meets a young boy.
Admiral Malkor awakens from his cocoon stronger than ever and determined to destroy the Megaforce Rangers.
The Megaforce Rangers' victory over the Warstar aliens is short-lived when they discover Metal Alice has turned Vrak into a powerful and menacing cyborg.
When Cyborg Vrak, Metal Alice and The Messenger launch a vicious attack against the Megaforce Rangers, it will take all their powers and abilities to save the earth.
Robo Knight learns the true meaning of Christmas from a group of children when he is mistaken for a donated Christmas toy and is shipped in a charity crate to a foreign land.

With that battle won, the civilians attempt to restore order. Back in the classroom, Mr. Burley lectures with new purpose, stating that when faced with great adversity the human spirit will always prevail. On the beach where Robo Knight fell, Troy remains pensive, more determined than ever to find their lost friend.
While the rest of the team works with the civilians to rebuild their city, Troy stumbles upon a plot by the Armada to launch missiles at major cities throughout the world.
After being defeated in battle by a master swordsman monster called Skatana, Noah wonders if he is worthy to be a Power Ranger anymore and ends up training to counter Skatana's attacks.
The Power Rangers take the Sky Ship to Animaria to look for the Red Lion Wild Zord. They soon find themselves in competition against General Peluso who is also after the Red Lion Wild Zord.

The emperor unleashes a powerful monster called Matacore to combat the Rangers. When fighting Matacore, the Power Rangers meet Jayden (the Red Samurai Ranger) and Mentor Ji who provide a disk to help them fight Matacore.

After the magnetic monster Pacha Chamak steals the Power Rangers' weapons, Jake and Emma consult with Casey Rhodes (the Jungle Fury Red Ranger who is now a part-time zookeeper) to learn a special form of martial arts.
When the Armada sends down X Borg platoons after X Borg platoons, the Megaforce Rangers have their encounter with the Silver Ranger even when they are facing off against Gorgax.
Orion explains his origins to the Rangers, Gosei, and Tensou. Meanwhile, Damaras sends Commander Osegain to Earth in a plot to destroy Orion.
When the Rangers are sidelined by an energy-draining monster named Skeltox, Jake must get over his jealousy of Orion and help him master the powers of the Sixth Rangers in order to defeat Skeltox.
The Rangers are sidetracked from fighting Sirjinkor when Tensou develops amnesia and wanders away from the Command Center.
A love potion made by Invidious accidentally makes Levira fall in love with Jake. Upon discovering this, Invidious plans to eliminate Jake so that he can have Levira for himself.

When the Legendary Megazord is damaged in a fight against Desolar (who is stealing the happiness from humans in order to cure Prince Vekar's cold), Emma uses unconventional methods to defeat this unusual monster.

eps.t: The Grass is Always Greener... or Bluer
eps.ov: A body-swapping monster named Tranceferer switches Jake and Noah's bodies while on a mission to swap the bodies of high-ranking people. While Tranceferer continues his mission, the monster Turtlelini is sent down to distract the Rangers causing Jake and Noah to handle fighting in each other's bodies.

The Rangers are lured away from Earth and into Corinth by Professor Cog who locks the wormhole to Corinth. While the Rangers work to tame the Turbo Falcon Zord, Professor Cog and his Grinders attack Earth and runs into competition in the form of the Armada. The Rangers must find a way to tame the Turbo Falcon Zord and find a way back to Earth to stop Professor Cog.
The Rangers finally battle Prince Vekar face to face when he comes to Earth armed with his very own Megazord.
Following Prince Vekar's destruction, Vrak resurfaces and makes his latest plan to destroy Earth with the help of a reprogrammed Robo Knight.
With two of the drills in the Earth, the Rangers must rescue Orion from Vrak and free Robo Knight from Vrak's control before the final drill can be placed.

Emperor Mavro comes to Earth following the deaths of his sons Vrak and Prince Vekar and replaces Prince Vekar's fleet with his own fleet. He also plans to punish Damaras for what happened to Prince Vekar, yet gives a chance to Damaras to redeem himself by destroying the Power Rangers.

Emperor Mavro launches an attack on Earth by calling all Armada forces across the galaxy to drop what they are doing in their positions and head to Earth. He also sends Levira to fight the Rangers in order to redeem herself for the death of Prince Vekar and Vrak and to make up for Damaras' failure.
When The Emperor nearly defeats the Rangers after a massive attack, the Rangers get help from Legendary Rangers from the past.

Millions of years after the mysterious and powerful Energems were entrusted to the now extinct dinosaurs for protection from a ruthless bounty hunter, a pair of courageous teens find themselves in possession of two of these long lost precious artifacts, and come face to face with a monster who will do everything in his power to steal them for himself.

A new teen finds his own Energem and joins Tyler and Shelby on their pilgrimage to the Dinosaur Museum, where they learn they are a part of the elite team called the Power Rangers. They are entrusted with protecting the Energems from a fierce bounty hunter named Sledge, who has returned and is more determined than ever to capture the Energems for himself.

Sledge arrives on Earth to confront Keeper and the Rangers. He gives them a deadline to return the Energems, but coming up with a plan to fight back gets compromised when Tyler goes after Fury on his own. Can the Rangers figure out how to work as a team?

Chase tries to help Koda adapt to modern day technology after he struggles to learn how to ride their new high tech Dino Cycles. But when they are caged in a cave by one of Sledge’s monsters, Koda must rely on his caveman instincts to escape and save his friend.

When a Maori fortune teller asks Chase for help guarding her shop from a potential thief, Chase is happy to help, but falls under a spell of Sledge’s latest monster, Spellbinder. The rest of the Rangers must quickly figure out how to help break Spellbinder’s hold on Chase before their friend is lost to them forever.
When faced with the fast-firing Cavity monster, Riley thinks Chase doesn’t take the threat seriously, but soon learns that Chase simply has a different approach.
When Sledge’s monster stings the Anklyo Zord, Shelby must use her advanced dino knowledge to tame the wild beast.
When clone Rangers steal the real Rangers' irreplaceable tracking device, Fury learns the location of the powerful Ptera Zord.
The Maze monster, working with Fury, captures the Rangers until Riley's logical mind helps them break free. But the delay has allowed Fury time to head toward the Ptera Zord.
When the Rangers find the Gold Energem among the Royal Treasure, they decide to impersonate a Prince and Princess to lure Fury in and gain control of the power Ptera Zord.
Koda and the Rangers fight to save an arrogant prince and the Gold Energem from Fury, but a powerful 800-year-old knight seizes the jewel for himself.
The Rangers must demonstrate their value to persuade their latest ally, the Gold Ranger, but find they do not have the willpower to do so when one of Sledge's monsters steals their courage.
A fun rivalry between Tyler and Ivan becomes a problem when it interferes with the efforts of the Rangers to find and defuse a bomb planted by Sledge's monsters.
When three Rangers become trapped in an underground tomb, it's a race against time for Chase to master his new power upgrade before his friends are lost forever.
When a monster kidnaps a Ranger and takes on their appearance during a Halloween party, Kendall must discover which of the team is the fake before their Energem is stolen.
Prince Phillip discovers money can't buy the respect of an Energem when he embarks on his own quest to become a Power Ranger.

eps.t: No Matter How You Slice It
eps.ov: When one of Sledge's monsters manages to break the Rangers' bonds of friendship, it's up to Riley and Koda to remind their team what they truly mean to each other.
When one of Sledge's transport pods is spotted in New Zealand, the Rangers head to Auckland and are shocked to discover the existence of a new Ranger.
With the Purple Energem in hand, the Rangers race to find the Plesio Zord before Sledge can destroy it for good.
While searching for a new Purple Ranger, the teens find all their personal wishes coming true in the worst way.
When Poisandra steals Santa's computer, it's up to the Rangers to get it back before Christmas is canceled.
With two Energems in Sledge's possession, the Rangers and Kendall must take the fight to his ship in order to save the world.

The Rangers believe their work is done after they've defeated Sledge and his evil monsters. Unbeknownst to them, an even more powerful monster is picking up where Sledge left off and is closer to the Rangers than they think.

Snide plans to contaminate the city water with venom that makes you forget who you are in hopes that the Rangers will be infected. Meanwhile, Riley has a score to settle with an old rival at the Amber Beach Marathon.

Shelby receives a pillow from an unknown sender. When she uses it to take a nap, she starts living a nightmare. The Rangers suspect this must be from Snide so they all make sure to stay awake, but that proves to be harder than they thought.

Chase tries to impress his new girlfriend, Kaylee by showing how talented and accomplished he is. But when it becomes more about him and less about her, Kaylee starts to fall for the Black Ranger instead.

Tyler tries to master the new T-Rex Super Charge Mode, but after Heckyl plants a virus in Kendall's computer, the T-Rex Super Charger malfunctions and makes Tyler go wild! Luckily, the Aqua Ranger is able to step in before it's too late.

Tyler looks forward to catching up with his dad after not seeing him for the past 10 years. When Tyler's Energem becomes cracked, he is forced to mend it by placing it in Hot Lava and prove to his dad he's not a kid anymore.

Kendall creates a new Victory Charger that requires the core 5 Energems. But when Riley becomes Koda's coach on the Amber Beach Earthquake baseball team, he has a hard time pulling himself away from the game to help the other Rangers.

When Ivan mistakes a thousand year old suit of armor as a training dummy, he finds himself in debt after destroying it. Heckyl sends in a hybrid monster named Spell Digger to spread greed to anyone who touches his gold coins.

Shelby's lifelong friend Erin starts to take credit for a song that Shelby wrote when they were kids. But when Erin starts to take credit for the work of the Pink Ranger, she quickly realizes how dangerous it can be to claim ownership of someone else's work.

The Silver Ranger contacts Kendall from the far reaches of space to let them know where the location of a new Zord. When Singe and Fury intercept the message it becomes a race to see who can get there first.

Poisandra's magic paint and brush are exactly what Beauticruel needs to make any guy she desires fall in love with her. Heckyl devises a plan to make the Rangers fall in love with her so he can steal their Energems

The Rangers discover the cave where Koda and his family once lived. Questioning the wise words of his Grandfather, Koda opens a section of the cave he was told to never enter, allowing an ancient monster to escape.

Chase is determined to master a dessert recipe from New Zealand, when a food critic visits the Dino Bite Café. Meanwhile, an evil monster comes to earth to find the Energems and takes control of the Zords and Megazords.
Tyler joins Shelby in auditioning for an open spot on the popular New Zealand band, The N-Zed Boys. Meanwhile, an ally arrives, but not before the Rangers suspects he has an ulterior motive.
The Rangers are forced to go to intergalactic trial for crimes against monsters.
The Rangers learn the history of their Energems from a newfound ally. Meanwhile, an epic battle ensues in the forest over the Silver Energem.
A monster switches the Rangers' bodies, thereby creating trouble for them. Ivan meets his look-alike who turns out to be his great great great grandson.
A new exhibit comes to the Amber Beach Museum: Worg, the robotic caveman. Arcanon sends a musician duo whose music can turn listeners into zombies.
A new monster attacks the Rangers, turning most of them to stone. Shelby must work with Keeper to create a new Zord, the only plan that can save her friends.
The Rangers find themselves needing help in their toughest fight yet as they do battle with Snide one final time, and Sledge's eggs hatch across the four corners of the Earth.
The Dark Energem creates a black hole that takes the Rangers back in time, as they must go to a prehistoric age for their final showdown with Sledge and Fury.
When the Power Rangers receive mysterious Secret Santa gifts, they uncover an evil plot to ruin Christmas.

A young teen named Brody escapes to Earth from an alien spaceship with a special artifact called the Ninja Nexus Prism. He and two new friends must unlock its secrets to defend it from the villainous champion Galvanax.
As Brody, Preston and Sarah return to Brody's childhood home in an attempt to find his lost family, Hayley and Calvin come across a strange alien named Mick.

Brody is accused of cheating on his first day of school after using his Data Comm to find answers. Now, he must use his own abilities and leadership skills to lead the Rangers against another threat from Galvanax.
Preston is amazed to discover that he has developed real magical abilities; Galvanax hatches a plan with a new monster to steal the ninja power stars.
When the Power Rangers are caught in the spider web prison of Galvanax's latest monster, Tangleweb, Calvin must conquer his fear to unlock a new power and save them.
Hayley is targeted by Galvanax’s latest monster. Isolated from the other Rangers, she and Redbot must work together to save themselves.

Determined to take part in as many student activities as she can, Sarah builds a device that allows her to clone herself, but the plan backfires when Galvanax's monster steals the technology for himself!
Both the Power Rangers and Galvanax attempt to find more information about the new mysterious Gold Ranger.
Levi is excited to be embarking on his world tour, but as mysterious earthquakes start shaking up Summer Cove, he's presented with a tough decision.
When Summer Cove's sentimental "Ribbon Tree" is in danger of being cut down by Preston's wealthy father, Preston must learn to stand up to his father to save what is important.
Galvanax's latest contestant poisons Brody and the Rangers must make the ultimate sacrifice to save him.
The Rangers access a powerful new Megazord formation to battle Ripcon.
Calvin finds himself increasingly distracted from his friends and Power Ranger duties when he spends all his time trying to impress his local hero.
A mysterious princess and her royal guard arrive on Earth to challenge the Rangers.
The Power Rangers band together with a new ally to try and defeat Galvanax's new champion -- but even their teamwork may not be enough.
The Power Rangers celebrate Halloween by playing a spooky new board game, but find the stakes bigger than they imagined.
Hayley and Calvin's relationship is tested when they both decide to run for student body president.
Redbot documents the adventures of the Power Rangers on his new blog, while a cat-like monster attempts to steal the Ninja Power Stars.
Preston must confront one of Galvanax's newest contestants after his magical spells backfire on his teammates.
While Sarah deals with issues at school, the Ninja Steel Rangers must overcome a force field.
Galvanax comes to Earth with a new, seemingly unstoppable plan to defeat the Power Rangers.
Sarah teams up with Santa Claus to save Christmas and the Power Rangers from a time-manipulating monster.
Madame Odius returns to Earth to track down the Ninja Nexus Prism.
When Calvin forgets his and Hayley's anniversary, he panics and ends up a spinning a web of lies to cover up his mistake.
Levi tries to change himself to impress a mysterious street performer.
When a monster threatens Summer Cove, the Rangers tap into the power of a new Megazord.
The students of Summer Cove High become addicted to a new video game.
The Galactic Ninjas arrive on Earth to destroy the Rangers once and for all.
Sarah tries to break the world hoverboard speed record using a strange new technology.
Brody is accused of stealing something from one of his teachers.
After their Zords are disabled by Odius' giant Foxatron, the Rangers must find a new way to stop her evil Zord.
In a very special 25th Anniversary episode, the Super Ninja Steel Rangers team up with Legendary Rangers in an epic battle to save the world.
Preston learns not to believe everything he hears.
Levi becomes overwhelmed by an overzealous fan.
Sarah and the team's overconfidence puts them all at risk.
A Space Sheriff is tricked into attacking the Rangers; Hayley learns an important lesson about respecting school rules.
The Rangers need the help of an unlikely ally when their technology is infected with a computer virus.
Calvin is faced with a tough decision when he is offered his dream job.
When a monster steals Levi's voice, he learns an important lesson about self-worth.
The Super Ninja Steel Rangers are ambushed by monsters who switch bodies with them.
One of Preston's spells accidentally causes unintended consequences for one of his favorite teachers which he must now fix.
Odius has a devious plan to create a massive army to control the world.
The Rangers must figure out how to save the citizens of Summer Cove and stop Odius once and for all.
The Rangers look to celebrate Christmas but find their holiday cheer interrupted by an old foe.
Scientists tap into the Morphin Grid, but an evil virus corrupts the technology and a new team of Power Rangers is formed to defend the Grid from evil.
When Grid Battleforce’s Commander needs to select a leader for the team, the Power Rangers are at odds over who should get the job.
Zoey tries to convince the citizens of Coral Harbor to use Morph-X powered bikes instead of cars, but Blaze uses the opportunity to execute an evil plan.
Ravi is shocked when the evil Roxy comes to his rescue and wonders if there may still be good left in her.
Devon finds it difficult to balance a new job he took to impress his dad and the duties of being the Red Power Ranger.
Nate develops new technology from a captured Gigadrone and Devon struggles with fully trusting his team.
Evox targets the Beast Bots to stop the Rangers from forming their Megazord.
Scrozzle executes his plan to finally free Evox from the Cyber Dimension and the Rangers, along with an unexpected friend, must do everything in their power to stop him.
The Rangers must band together to save one of their own from Evox's new plan.
Ravi must face one of his worst fears when it interferes with his Ranger duties.
An innocent lie leads to a break in trust between the Power Rangers.
When Nate and Steel unexpectedly clash, it leads to double trouble for the team.
After witnessing a boy being bullied, Ravi takes him under his wing.
The Rangers are hypnotized into believing that they are the characters they dressed up as for Halloween.
The Rangers' skills are put to the test when Blaze uses evil tech to massively enhance his Robotron's destructive power.
The Red Ranger gets amazing new powers, but they have unexpected side effects.
Ravi resorts to drastic measures when Smash accidentally discovers a closely guarded secret.
When a movie star comes to town, the Rangers' secret identities are unexpectedly threatened.
The Rangers are brainwashed to think that Blaze and Roxy are part of their team.
Evox and his minions hatch the ultimate plan to take over the Morphin Grid.
The Rangers mount a desperate mission to stop Evox once and for all.
When the Rangers get trapped inside holiday ornaments, their Beast Bots must save both the Rangers and the city.
The Rangers are skeptical when Steel says he's found clues that proves Evox may have returned.
A huge trash spill at the beach endangers the local wildlife; Scrozzle sets about finding reinforcements.
It’s not all fun and games when Devon’s favorite video game is brought to life in the form of a new Robotron.
Ravi secretly repaints a local art mural, but a strange artist arrives and claims the work as his own.
Devon discovers that Cruise has some skills that will help the Rangers in battle and pushes him to join the team.
Steel learns the concept of discipline and takes it too far, putting one of the Rangers in real danger.
The Rangers are given access to a powerful new Zord, but Evox has designs to steal it for himself.
The Pan Global Games arrive in Coral Harbor, but Ranger duties prevent the teens from attending any of the events.
Steel learns that Nate and Zoey have feelings for each other and tries to bring them together, despite the strict Grid Battleforce rules that forbid relationships between Rangers.
Grid Battleforce shuts down the Morph-X towers to lure Evox into a trap.
The Rangers receive a strange message from outer space warning of an impending threat.
The Rangers do everything they can to help their new ally return home.
A hasty decision by Zoey puts an old friend in danger.
Evox decides to add a new villain to his team and commands his minions to find the evilest villain of all time.
In an epic battle, the Beast Morphers team up with the Dino Thunder, Dino Charge, and Mighty Morphin Power Rangers to defeat the newest member of Evox's team.
Nate is reunited with his do-gooder parents, who offer him a compelling and difficult choice.
Ravi and Roxy's anniversary hits a major snag when a misunderstanding gets out of control.
Nate and Steel accidentally swap bodies!
When Zoey accidentally ruins her brother's chances for a scholarship, she’ll do anything to make it right.
Devon falls victim to a bad influence, which affects his relationship with Cruise.
Nate makes a horrifying discovery and must rely on the wisdom of an ally to help him work through it.
Evox finally executes his master plan, and the Rangers must do everything they can to stop him, even potentially sacrifice one of their own.

Reporter Amelia accompanies Ollie and his mom, Dr. Akana, to investigate the mysterious Dinohenge statues; the trio run into an evil warrior named Void Knight and a threat that puts the entire world in danger.
Ollie carries out a plan to catch Sporix without his teammates' knowledge; Ollie realizes the benefit of working as a team.

The Rangers intercept a mysterious message from outer space and Zayto is desperate to know if it was sent from his home planet; unable to decipher the message and losing hope, Zayto remembers another important message from the past.
General Boomtower tries to steal a mysterious orb from the city museum; when the Rangers struggle to stop him, they get help from an unexpected source.
Izzy is determined to win a big race with the help of her Special Olympics athlete cousin, Lily; after Lily misses a training session and Izzy rejects more help, her sportsmanship is put to the test.
Amelia thinks she's cursed with bad luck and is reluctant to help the Rangers, afraid she'll cause more harm; Amelia learns the truth about luck when monsters attack the base.
The Warden takes away Javi's keytar, putting him in a bad mood, which he refuses to explain to the team. Javi is forced to open up about his problems in order to find his Zord.
A familiar face arrives on Earth and Zayto dismisses his quest as a distraction; after he saves the Rangers from a powerful Sporix Beast, Zayto realizes an important lesson.
The Rangers tease Ollie for bringing all of his gadgets on a camping trip. But his tech might be their only hope when sinister Sporix suddenly attack.
A knight from Zayto's home planet suddenly appears at Dinohedge with a message that might be too good to be true... and Solon has her suspicions.
Amelia hunts for ghosts at a creepy mansion. But there's no supernatural sighting -- only a fierce face-off with pyramid-shaped Tombtress.
Izzy is convinced a new coach is going to take her athletics to the next level. However, her training aspirations are put to the test when she discovers the coach's true motivations
Javi thinks Izzy has a crush on a friend and he sets them up on a date, but his assumption causes big problems when the monsters smell love in the air.
Ollie boasts to his friends that he's afraid of nothing. But when the other Dino Fury Rangers are captured by a formidable foe, Ollie realizes his biggest fear.
Ollie agrees to help Javi with a story, but his desire for new tech distracts him from his promise. The villains exploit his obsession, and Ollie learns a lesson about priorities.
Aiyon, the new Gold Ranger, reveals the dark truth about Zayto's past and the Dino Fury Rangers learn what makes a true leader.
Getting a free ice cream for a heroic act goes to Aiyon's head. But later on, when his Zord is captured, he learns what it means to be a true hero.
Izzy attempts to hide her struggles in electronics class put the Rangers at risk when they need those skills during a battle.
The villains use a Sporix Beast with body-swapping powers to chase pirate treasure, interrupting Amelia's attempts to make over Pop-Pop for a date.
Zayto is trapped on a distant planet seeking new Zords, and Aiyon makes a risky trip to save him. Together, they confront the nightmares of their past.
The Rangers need Dr. Akana's help to stop Void Knight's evil scheme. But Ollie disagrees with Zayto's plan, afraid it will put his mother in danger.
While the Rangers fight to get Santa's magic sketchbook back from the villains, Javi and Solon are caught in a trap. Will they escape?
Void Knight suddenly returns, and a new member of his vicious crew joins Slyther and Mucus in tricking the Rangers and stealing a valuable Dino Key.
The Rangers must divide their fighting duties when Slyther and pirate robot Wreckmate challenge each other to see who can be more destructive.
Solon's system gets an update. Javi, Izzy and the Rangers spot a Sporix beast — but not before evil Occulo tries to nab it first.
Aiyon reconnects with a shrunken Zord, but Occulo and Wreckmate try chasing it down for Void Knight's secret plans.
Izzy gets frustrated about the outfit her mom designed for the prom.  The Rangers battle a Sporix creature with an appetite for trash.
Javi notices a powerful Dino Key on a band leader’s necklace. The Rangers power up to face off against Void Knight’s nasty new gizmo.
Santaura convinces Void Knight and wicked Squashblight to contaminate the city’s water supply and turn all the residents into trees.
The Rangers question Void Knight’s intentions. Santaura comes up with a new strategy to hunt down her former partner in crime.
Amelia leads the crew on a search for a ghost caught on camera. A new robot programmed to crush and conquer hunts down the Rangers.
Aiyon and Izzy find a secret stash of cash — and a powerful necklace that turns creatures mega-sized.
Javi must come up with a new tune after his song for a competition is stolen. Mucus suggests a fresh way to beat the Rangers.

When Jane vetoes a Buzzblast story on bigfoot, Amelia tells Stan and Annie to bend the rules and publish it anyway, but when her colleagues end up in danger, Amelia learns an important lesson about responsibility.
Ollie tries to ask Amelia out, but a miscommunication leads to Amelia thinking he doesn't like her.
The Ranger teens head to Rafkon to stop Lord Zedd, but because of a prophecy, Aiyon takes unnecessary risks.

The other Morphin Masters are angry to discover the Green Morphin Master has broken their vow to never intervene in mortal affairs. But when the Rangers and the Green Morphin Master work together, the Morphin Masters have a change of heart.
When a monster's meddling gives Javi a big break, he must come to terms with the fact that the key to success is hard work.
Fern is offered a place at an elite sports college; Fern and Izzy's relationship is put to three test.
Izzy is torn following Fern's acceptance to a faraway college. The Rangers try to stop Quickspine and Mucus from stealing Carlos' key.
When Izzy and Javi are hit by blasts from a special weapon, they're brainwashed into helping the Void Queen with her plot to steal the Sporix.
A band of Rafkonians arrive looking to colonize Earth, but the Rangers talk them into joining forces to stop the Void Queen's Sporix beasts.
As citizens flee in the wake of the Sporix beast invasion, the Rangers find an energy cocoon created by the Void Queen that could destroy Pine Ridge.
After Tarrick moves the energy cocoon outside of the city, the Rangers must do battle with the Void Queen and her massive Nemesis beast.
Bajillia enlists Lord Zedd to lead her armies in an intergalactic war — and things only get worse when the two capture a Power Ranger for their team.
Team Cosmic Fury prepares for a possible invasion from Lord Zedd while Amelia tries to cure an evilized Ranger and Javi learns to accept his new loss.
Stranded on a faraway planet with no powers, Team Cosmic Fury scrambles to figure out a way home while Earth suffers an invasion from enemy forces.
Ollie races Team Cosmic Fury to find Zayto, but the Zenith Ranger's location is anyone's guess. They'd better move fast though: Lord Zedd's forces loom!
When Bajillia discovers a long-lost Zord on a mining planet, the Rangers must create a musical distraction to stop her from using it as a war weapon.
Solon goes missing right as the Rangers prepare to fly the base back to Earth. But the team has bigger problems: Ollie's tracker has led him to Erridus.
To save Pine Ridge, Team Cosmic Fury must dismantle the system of Squidrills creating an anti-Zord forcefield around Earth — with the help of a spy.
Two ex-villains should be the last people to cure Ollie, but Aiyon has a plan that just might work. Meanwhile, Zayto's secret becomes harder to hide.
The connection to the Morphin Grid is in danger, unless the team can travel to Eltar and take back the Master Captivator and Ollie — without backup.
If Team Cosmic Fury can't stabilize the Master Captivator, a wave of pure evil threatens to wipe out all the good in the universe. No pressure, right?
